category.blurb: Stories with no class, trigger, or chain link in the XML — invoked directly by game systems (tribe diplomacy, scenario scripts, traits, and other engine hooks).
category.label: Scripted & Special

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A Captured Lion

options.text: Talent is talent. Bring [character] into the fold.
I don't like it. Let's treat him as we would any other prisoner.

events.text: Your recent battles against the [tribe] have been hard fought but not without gains. After a recent skirmish, your forces managed to capture [character] who is not only a warrior of some renown but also has a history of friendship with your People. Initially, there was some talk of ransoming him back to the [tribe] but given that there's no love lost between them, perhaps there are better ways of dealing with this prisoner...

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Covert Faux Pas

options.text: If that is the cost of silence, then so be it.
Do not threaten your [title].

events.text: In one of your hideouts, you find yourself in a deadly situation. <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CORRUPT>Your latest shipment of illicit goods has arrived, but you were discovered by [character].<p=SUBJECT_GREEDY>While you were skimming a bit of money from the caravan taxes, you were discovered by [character].<p=SUBJECT_BLOODTHIRSTY>While you were torturing a suspected enemy agent, you were discovered by [character].<p=SUBJECT_RUTHLESS>While you were interrogating a suspected enemy agent, you were discovered by [character].<else>After visiting the black market to find a new diversion, you were discovered by [character].<end> "I do wonder what the people would think if they heard about this," he says with a knowing smile. "How about we come to an arrangement over this dirty little secret?" You can't help but wonder if [character] orchestrated the whole business to put you in this predicament.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A Debt Repaid

options.text: Indeed. The addition to a new, skilled merchant to our inner circle would certainly settle accounts.
I would consider the matter settled if you gifted us the service of a talented General.
Regardless of how skilled the offered Courtiers may be, holding onto the favor for the time being is more valuable still.

events.text: Some time ago, you acted in the service of [character], so you're not at all surprised when he comes to you in private one afternoon, seeking to settle accounts. "I remain deeply appreciative of your efforts on my behalf, and would like to settle accounts with you. If I were to bolster your staff with some of my own talent, would that be sufficient?"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Different School of Thought

options.text: The monks of [city] should be able to add to the traditions of [religion].
Send messengers to tell the monks of [city] to desist.
I refuse to be drawn into these internal squabbles.

events.text: The monks of [city] are at odds with the wider [religion] community over their interpretations of the Vinaya, the rules for monks laid down during the life of the Buddha by the first disciples. These divides are steadily deepening as each sect of monks have started producing their own texts and rules. The monks of [city] have asked for your backing as a vital sponsor of [religion].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Family Warning

options.text: Rumors are not to be trusted.
No one questions our policies!
We will consider reforms.

events.text: [character], a member of house [family], arrives with urgent counsel. He confesses that members of his Family question the motives behind some of our recent decisions, and have even begun to speak openly of our alleged corruption. "Something must be done to quell this traitorous talk," he advises.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Feeble Force

options.text: Volunteers are the core of our military.
A trained, standing army will keep us safe.

events.text: The great soldier [character] has overheard the [family] grousing about the size of our army, and how volunteers should be enlisted to bolster its size. [character] restates his confidence in professional soldiers, and worries that unprofessional volunteers would put the nation's security at risk.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Flame in the Wind

options.text: Assure [character] that rituals of [religion] will be protected at all costs.
All are free to pursue Nirvana, the blowing out of the burning mind.
"Yes, [character]. It is at the very top of my list."

events.text: [religion] has been teaching that the religion is a personal path. No rituals or priestly interventions are needed, just a curious mind and the mental rigor needed for self-discovery. This does not sit well with the Priests of [religion]. Especially not with [character], who has been doggedly speaking daily about the problem at great length.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A Friend Indeed...

options.text: I am the leader. We can afford it if I say we can.
Probably best not to risk it.

events.text: Your whole life, everyone has considered you to be weak. Everyone but [character]. He seems unaccountably fond of you, despite what everyone else says and despite the hard-edged reputation of the [tribe]. In recent months, [character] has been encouraging you to get out of your comfort zone, offering to accompany you on a number of...well, you'd call them terrifying adventures, where most people would call them typical days in the wildnerness. In any case, you're sorely tempted. Naturally, you'd want to outfit yourself with every tool imaginable in order to maximize your chances of returning home safely, but you understand why [character] is pushing you in this diretion, and deep down, you do appreciate it. The question is, can your Realm afford the added expense of your adventures?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Generous Offer?

options.text: How generous!
This would only come back to bite me.

events.text: [character] has sent a message offering to provide you with a large donation of stone cut from his land. However, there is a catch. Accepting means that you will owe him a favor later down the line. Do you put yourself in debt to [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Gift to Remember

options.text: Graciously accept.
This will make a fine gift for the heir.

requirements.label: Warlike / Cruel
tip: The leader must have one of: Warlike; Cruel

options.text: Saddle the beast for war.

events.text: The wrinkled colossus watches you with eyes that hold a wealth of intelligence. [character] has presented you with a sixty year old elephant; a symbolic and regal gift of an admirable animal in the height of its prime.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Holy State

options.text: He is right. We must take this fateful step.
[character] does not speak for the gods.
I keep my own beliefs, as should you.
We do not want [religion] dominating life in [rival].

events.text: The rise of [religion] has inspired many in the court to question [rival]'s lack of a State Religion. [character] has become the most outspoken proponent of the idea. "No man should be expected to rule alone, without the wisdom of the divine," explains [character]. "Do this now, and we can do it together."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Keen Eye

options.text: Review all existing [rival] maps carefully.
Recruit local [rival] as guides.
Assemble a massive intelligence-seeking effort.

events.text: You spend hours listening to your spies bicker over the best way to gather intelligence on your rival, [rival]. However, your keen eye notices several options immediately. Sometimes, you wonder why the court is even necessary.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: A Luxurious Demand

options.text: If it keeps the [family] happy...
They forget their place.

events.text: As our treasuries fill with the finest luxuries, the [family] family has come to demand a cut of the wealth. They desire more of our collected [resource], or they will make our job of governing difficult. What shall we tell them?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Martial Faux Pas

options.text: Yes, Yes. I do.
Do not make demands of your [title].

events.text: At a gathering of your generals, you find yourself in an untenable position. Your generals take offense at every plan you suggest, until [character] provides an alternative solution that satisfies everyone. After the meeting [character] stops you. "Your highness, I saved you back there. You owe me." You wonder if [character] orchestrated the whole business with this <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TIMID>eagerness to die stupidly.<p=SUBJECT_SPOILED>unwillingness to bring my favorite pastries.<p=SUBJECT_INSANE>unwillingness to measure the spears of your generals.<p=SUBJECT_FOOLISH>unwillingness to consult the frogs before battle.<else>setup.<end>

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A More Prosperous Future

options.text: We should absolutely pay to bring [character] to Court.
I think no...instead of that, let us fund a caravan and send [character] with it.
Encourage [character] to learn from [character], but do not formally bring him to Court.

events.text: [character] is making you proud as the heir apparent and one day leader of your Realm. Already, he has made important connections that will serve him well when he eventually takes the reins of power. One of those connections is [character] of the [tribe]. A talented trader, he would make an excellent addition to the Court...

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A Night to Remember

options.text: I accept your gracious offer of tribute.
I choose to avail myself of the wisdom of your ministers.
I would like to see my troops trained by your finest warriors, and benefit from their skills myself.
I need nothing but your friendship.

events.text: Another birthday and another year older. Sometimes, the weight of leadership presses heavily upon you, and you feel each and every one of those years. This year, however, [character] appeared unexpectedly in your Court to celebrate with you. During the feasting and merriment he leaned in close and whispered in your ear: "We may not always see eye to eye, but I know you to be an honorable man. That is a rare thing indeed in the world we live in, and I appreciate and admire it. As a token of my esteem, I shall offer you your choice of gifts from my Tribe. I offer you a tribute to your greatness, the wisdom of my Ministers, or training, courtesy of my finest warriors." What will you select?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Regal Faux Pas

options.text: Fine, fine. You have me.
Who will believe your word against the [title]'s?

events.text: After a meeting of the court, you find yourself caught in an indecent situation with a member of the palace staff. [character] stumbles upon the pair of you and watches with a knowing smile. "My lips are sealed... for a price," he says as the servant leaves. You wonder if [character] orchestrated the whole business with this <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_DEBAUCHED>libertine revelry.<p=SUBJECT_WANTON>shameless servant.<p=SUBJECT_DRUNK>unmixed wine.<p=SUBJECT_ROMANTIC>exotic interest.<else>setup.<end>

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Show of Faith

options.text: Give a very generous (and very public) donation.
Send him away, this is their own concern.
Lead a public service in the capital.

requirements.label: Blessed / Humble
tip: The leader must have one of: Blessed; Humble

options.text: Publicly credit the [religion] faith with the nation's successes and good fortune.

events.text: A leader amongst the has asked for an audience. He talks in a slow and sombre voice about your duties as a leader and how the [religion] faithful look to you as an example. The suggests that a show of support for the State Religion would help you both, increasing the fervor of the [religion].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Simple Monk

options.text: Ask the monk to accompany you so you may learn more.
Reflect on the monk’s strength of character.
Ask for a blessing before continuing on.

events.text: As you tour the towns around [city], you meet a young monk by the side of the road begging for alms. When you move to dismiss him, something about the monk’s tranquility holds you back. To be in such a rough position in life and to handle it with such fearlessness and grace is something that you have seen many fail at. A few hours later you are still in conversation, the monk telling you all about his life as a follower of [religion].

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Taste of Things to Come

options.text: Ominous.

events.text: Our latest delegation to the [tribe] have all been slaughtered and their heads placed on spikes along the road to [city]. Your advisors note that this may indicate worsened relations in the future.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Terrible Threat

options.text: Grim news!

events.text: A messenger from the [tribe] awaits you at court today. They bear a message from [character]. “The time of [rival] is at an end. I have decided to destroy you. I tell you this so that you know your downfall is by my hand. It amuses me for you to know, and yet be unable to avoid it.”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Time to Reap

options.text: Imprison [character] before he leaves the palace.
I can secure [character]'s allegiance with gold.
Convince [character] to calm the rabble rousers.
Let him go.

events.text: One afternoon, [character] awaits you at the steps of the throne, shifting uncomfortably. He confesses to a growing unease with your heartless and ruthless methods, revealing that he is leaving the court to take up with outspoken rebels. "The time is coming when you will reap what you have sown."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Toast

options.text: [character] is right to be upset. Imprison [character]!
[character] is overreacting.
Let them duel!

events.text: While dining in the company of [character], our [character] gives a toast dripping with innuendo and sarcasm, "Here's to our true [rival] heir!" [character] takes offense and calls for the General to be reprimanded.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: A Touch of the Exotic

options.text: We graciously accept this generous offer.
While we appreciate the generosity, we feel we must reciprocate.

events.text: Though you and [character] come from very different worlds, you do share similar tastes and interests that tend toward the exotic. It is in this spirit that [character] comes to you bearing an extraordinary offer. "In my recent travels, I chanced upon a land where they grew a remarkable delicacy. Called 'Olives,' they grow on trees in carefully cultivated groves. When I saw them, I couldn't resist the urge to bring some home. They cost me a fortune, but I think the expense was worth it. Then I recalled that you and I share similar tastes. If you're interested, I shall give you half of the saplings I brought home as a gesture of goodwill" What say you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A [religion] Council

options.text: My current council are the best people for [rival].

events.text: The [religion] Priests have sent a delegation to voice their concern. They are worried that despite the adoption of [religion] as our State Religion, those closest to you are not followers of the faith. Will you commit to a council of the faithful?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Abducting the Heir

options.text: I will not prey on a child for political gain.
Kidnap the boy, but do not harm him.
Kill him, and pull the weed before it takes root.

events.text: On a recent voyage abroad, the [family] family overheard some interesting news: [character], the heir to the [rival] throne, has embarked on a diplomatic tour of the outskirts of his kingdom. Resources are stretched, and the royal retinue will be small. The [family] believe this is the perfect opportunity to kidnap [character] and hold him for ransom.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Adrift

options.text: We must protect [religion] and its people.
They are welcome to depart [rival].
Aid them in their voyage to a new land.

events.text: [religion] pilgrims from the city of [city] have come to court with an unusual request. They wish to build a flotilla of sailboats with which they can depart our shores forever. According to their story, they have been the target of systemic abuse and oppression for many years, and they hope to establish a new home in a faraway land. What shall we tell them?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: After Dark

options.text: [character] must have an armed escort... for protection.
Use favors to gain [character]'s approval.
Perhaps a few years in a cell will cool their passions.
Leave them be for now.

events.text: Agents in the court regret to inform us that [character] has been seen frequenting the haunts of your enemies including [character]. While respected, [character] has made numerous public threats against you and is considered a potential challenger to your rule. The actions of [character] must be addressed.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Against [character]

options.text: Allow the work to circulate.
Order the work be banned.

events.text: [character] has written a text defending the laws of [religion] against the arguments of the non-believer [character], emphasizing the long and detailed history of the religion. The work is quickly spreading among scholarly circles and becoming increasingly popular. [character] begs you to ban the work so that he may save face.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Independence

options.text: We must invest in researching new military techniques.
We shall call up additional forces and drill the military.
We can afford to rest. There is peace, and the people are safe.

events.text: Our nation remains strong under your leadership. Some say it is stronger than ever before! The building of fortifications and the national transportation of horses, camels, and elephants for military production has led to a military that is renowned across the world. Peace fills the land and our armies remain ever watchful. We shall remain independent and, if need be, we shall defend that independence by force of arms. [rival] shall rely upon itself and none other. How shall we strengthen it further?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Learning

options.text: We shall focus on educating the people.
We must continue to explore new frontiers of knowledge.
We are obliged to utilize our brightest minds on military matters.

events.text: [rival] enjoys an era of scholarship and learning, such as has never been seen before in the history of our nation. Wisdom and knowledge flow freely throughout our cities, revealing understanding where before there was only superstition. We are a shining beacon of enlightenment in an ignorant and foolish world. How shall we further advance the cause of education and the observation of nature and humankind?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Allies of Convenience

options.text: Accuse the two of plotting in court.
Win back [character] with promises of affection.
Threaten [character] to stay away from [character].
Let the relationship develop as it will.

events.text: Jilted by your recent slights, [character], has begun appearing in court and openly allying with [character], one of your greatest critics. The two seem to be forging a political alliance. If allowed to blossom, an alliance between [character] and [character] could be disastrous.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Ambassador Candidates

options.text: Choose [character].
Choose [character].
I will make my own decisions!

events.text: After a series of fiery arguments, the [family] and [family] families have both put forward candidates for the position of Ambassador. Difficult choices are the bane of leadership.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Act of Bravery

options.text: Let us immortalize the deed by erecting a statue in [city].
Reward [character] with coin and a feast in his honor.
Although the deed is certainly worthy of more, all we can afford at present is a heartfelt thank you.

events.text: Long have you respected [character] for his selflessness and bravery. He is a talented leader, and you've made no secret of your admiration and respect. Recently, [character] once more proved to be worthy of that admiration and respect. A report has reached your ears that more than a dozen of your citizens were set upon by a pack of wolves. Many would have been killed, if not for the sudden appearance of [character] in thier midst. Unasked and unafraid, he defended your People, singlehandedly holding the wolves at bay until they could make their escape. The news fills you with a great swell of pride, even as you recognize it as a political opportunity. How do you wish to respond to this incredible act of bravery?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Iron Giant

options.text: Very good that he has a doting protector. We should hire [character] and make it official.
If [character] is going to continue to linger at Court, redirect his attention to training our troops, which is of more immediate value.
Send word to [character] and sing [character] praises.

events.text: It seems that [character] has a new friend and guardian. [character] has taken a liking to the child and spends lots of time talking to him and is ever watchful of potential threats. It heartens you to see such behavior from one who has nothing in particular to gain from such an act, and it strikes you as genuine affection.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: An Oath of Support

options.text: “Very well, I will swear this oath.”
Refuse to bind yourself to the [family] family.

events.text: [character] of the [family] approaches with a proposition. “[character], we have a unique chance to help each other. I understand that more troops may be needed for the war, but in return I want an oath that you will help the [family] should we ever ask for aid.” The [family] are offering some impressive spearmen and some of their finest chariots. Is it worth making a promise with unknown consequences though?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Offer We May Not Want To Refuse...

options.text: A bargain at the offered price!
We have no need of your troops.

events.text: A messenger has arrived from the land of the Danes with an intriguing offer. [character] finds himself with a strong military, but a shortage of resources. And, his message suggests, “perhaps we can both benefit from this situation”. For a modest fee you can acquire the services of a powerful Huscarl 2, a rare sight outside Tribal lands. “Of course”, the message concludes, “if you refuse I will need to find some other use for my excess forces." Shall we accept?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Offer We May Not Want To Refuse...

options.text: A bargain at the offered price!
We have no need of your troops.

events.text: A messenger has arrived from the land of the Gauls with an intriguing offer. [character] finds himself with a strong military, but a shortage of resources. And, his message suggests, “perhaps we can both benefit from this situation”. For a modest fee you can acquire the services of a powerful Gaesata 2, a rare sight outside Tribal lands. “Of course”, the message concludes, “if you refuse I will need to find some other use for my excess forces." Shall we accept?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Offer We May Not Want To Refuse...

options.text: A bargain at the offered price!
We have no need of your troops.

events.text: A messenger has arrived from the land of the Numidians with an intriguing offer. [character] finds himself with a strong military, but a shortage of resources. And, his message suggests, “perhaps we can both benefit from this situation”. For a modest fee you can acquire the services of a powerful Libyan Cavalry 2, a rare sight outside Tribal lands. “Of course”, the message concludes, “if you refuse I will need to find some other use for my excess forces." Shall we accept?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Offer We May Not Want To Refuse...

options.text: A bargain at the offered price!
We have no need of your troops.

events.text: A messenger has arrived from the land of the Scythians with an intriguing offer. [character] finds himself with a strong military, but a shortage of resources. And, his message suggests, “perhaps we can both benefit from this situation”. For a modest fee you can acquire the services of a powerful Amazon Cavalry 2, a rare sight outside Tribal lands. “Of course”, the message concludes, “if you refuse I will need to find some other use for my excess forces." Shall we accept?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Offer We May Not Want To Refuse...

options.text: A bargain at the offered price!
We have no need of your troops.

events.text: A messenger has arrived from the land of the Thracians with an intriguing offer. [character] finds himself with a strong military, but a shortage of resources. And, his message suggests, “perhaps we can both benefit from this situation”. For a modest fee you can acquire the services of a powerful Peltast 2, a rare sight outside Tribal lands. “Of course”, the message concludes, “if you refuse I will need to find some other use for my excess forces." Shall we accept?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Offer We May Not Want To Refuse...

options.text: A bargain at the offered price!
We have no need of your troops.

events.text: A messenger has arrived from the land of the Vandals with an intriguing offer. [character] finds himself with a strong military, but a shortage of resources. And, his message suggests, “perhaps we can both benefit from this situation”. For a modest fee you can acquire the services of a powerful Clubthrower 2, a rare sight outside Tribal lands. “Of course”, the message concludes, “if you refuse I will need to find some other use for my excess forces." Shall we accept?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: An Unlikely Partnership

options.text: We will provide food to our neighbors for assistance organizing a Caravan.
We will pay the upkeep of [tribe] scouts and ministers for a year in exchange for their knowledge of the area and expertise.
We will trade Civics for Military Preparedness.
We do not want, or need help from the tribes.

events.text: An unexpected opportunity presents itself with the arrival of a small band of fierce looking [tribe] warriors at the gates of [city]. While there are some initial delays due to the language barrier, once that gets worked out, the leader of the group informs you that the [tribe] are impressed with you and yours, and as you are relative newcomers to the region who have treated them fairly thus far, they would like to talk about trading opportunities, depending on your most pressing needs. How do you wish to respond to their offer?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: An Unlikely Scenario

options.text: No, this is madness.
Obey the priests.

events.text: We have received a very strange request. Our [religion] priests believe that with the proper sacrifice, their higher power will instruct them in the knowledge of... time travel. Shall we make a sacrifice?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: As Still as Death

options.text: Stop, I am not dead!

events.text: After a delicious meal prepared by your talented [tribe] cook, you retire to bed, where you ease into a peaceful slumber. Later, you wake to find that you cannot move. Your body lies prone and lifeless. Limbs, stiff. Flesh, cold. You are aware enough to witness the panic and sorrow of your servants as they mistake you for dead. Terrified, you realize what has happened. The vengeful [character] has worked his machinations and poisoned you through your once loyal cook.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ascetic Aesthetics

options.text: Maybe this life is not for him.
Maybe life is not for him.
Just get him out of my palace.

events.text: For someone who has forsaken all ties to worldly possessions and goods, [character] certainly has a lot of opinions on the way your palace has been decorated.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ascetic Dissent

options.text: Issue a royal order for the ascetic's removal.
Let them keep their hermit.
Perhaps it is [character] who ought to leave.

events.text: The people of [city] have grown used to having a Local Ascetic living in their midst. However, [character] is not as pleased by the resident philosopher, arguing that the hermit preaches an extreme way of living and is encouraging radical ideas. Attempts to drive the ascetic out of the city have met with surprising amounts of resistance from the people.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Autonomous Vassal

options.text: I trust [character] to guide the city well.
Laws can be rewritten if needed.

events.text: Your vassals are happy under your rule, the [family] Family especially adapting to their role. Feeling favored above all others, they are loyal and eager to serve. However, this is tested when [character] comes to you and asks for autonomous rule of [city], citing an unexpected loophole in the laws that leaves the city under their command rather than the crown's. Should such independence be allowed?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Autonomy in [city]

options.text: Let them rule over themselves as long as they pay their taxes.
Never! Find a noble, [rival] husband for [character].

events.text: The city of [city] would like to establish autonomy and rule itself independently from [rival]. A prominent figure, named [character], would like to reign over the city as its Governor.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Ban Manichaeism?

options.text: Ban Manichaean gatherings and public displays.
Continue to allow open worship of Manichaeism.
Reach out to [rival] about your shared beliefs.

events.text: Ever since the court heard news that [rival] had become a Manichaeism nation, politicians have demanded a response. Some view this as an opportunity to halt the spread of Manichaeism. They call for a ban of all gatherings, churches, and practices of these "vegetarian demon-worshippers." Many of our subjects follow the teachings of Mani, but perhaps the political climate should dictate our stance.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Bargaining Chips

options.text: This seems like a good trade. We shall part with some of our luxuries in exchange for a Great Merchant.
I like it. Let's leverage our luxuries to add a Great Soldier to the court.
No. We'll keep our luxuries for the time being.

events.text: Your vassals, the [family] family, know well that you have access to luxuries they do not. They want what they see as their share, but are willing to make a trade. If you would be good enough to part with some, they will give you your choice of courtiers. What say you?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Battle in the Skies

options.text: This is a sign to redouble our efforts against [rival]. To arms!
There is nothing to fear as long as I am obeyed. I will protect [city] as I protect everyone.
What a fascinating insight into rare natural phenomena! More study is needed...

events.text: Reports abound of the strangest sightings in the sky above [city]. At daybreak, two red arcs appeared in the sun, followed by blood-red orbs and a variety of rods across the sky. The many shapes started fighting among themselves, flying back and forth for no less than an hour. As the sun grew stronger, the strange shapes burned bright and then faded away, and lastly a large black spear drifted across the sky. Unbelievable as it sounds, the event was witnessed by many in [city], and there is concern that something of great significance has come to pass.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Belonging to Shruti

options.text: It may not be the usual food, but I will offer my [trait] to the gods.
I will make a sacrifice of animals from the royal lands.
I will give the traditional grains and incense.

events.text: Although increasingly rare, the Homa rites of the Vedic texts are still performed across [rival] as a way of offering sacrifice to make a request of the gods of [religion]. [character] has asked if you would care to make a sacrifice to ask for protection for the nation. Will you offer anything to the fire?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Birds of a Feather

options.text: No need to force it. Simply continuing to spend time with [character] will naturally improve relations with the [tribe]
Focus our cooperation on military matters, with an eye toward mutual defense.
Cooperate primarily on projects that will help improve the lives of our two Peoples.

events.text: You and [character] have fallen into an easy friendship thanks to your similar, affable natures. The two of you are often found in each other's company, riding, visiting one another's lands, and talking about ways to help improve the lives of your two Peoples. In a world fraught with violence and peril, this bodes well indeed, and presents a unique opportunity. How will you leverage this budding friendship?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Biting the Hand

options.text: Rally a loyal militia in [city].
Appeal to the masses for peace.
Hope that it all blows over.

events.text: After months of discontent, the great courtier [character] has chosen to declare his anger publicly. As unrest in [city] grows, he has joined the rabble, fomenting rebellion throughout the city. [character] and his followers have one goal: to overthrow the [title] and seize the throne.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Blinded by the Light

options.text: We will draft protections for religious practitioners.
Their faith must protect them. If not, then so be it.
It is time for us all to seek divine protection.

events.text: On a meditative walk outside his home, [character] is assaulted by ruffians shouting curses and threats against [religion]. The attack leaves him blind and unable to walk. Members of the [religion] leadership and the [family] family come to court allied against any further persecution, demanding that something be done.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Blood in the Streets

options.text: Send your patrols to protect [religion] homes and temples.
Secure [religion] landmarks and neighborhoods.
The court will not put itself in the middle of this conflict.

requirements.label: Blessed / Charming character
tip: The leader must have one of: Blessed; Charming character (a character trait)

options.text: Personally make an appeal to both groups of followers, in the name of respect and unity.

events.text: The strain between [religion] and [religion] followers has led to instances of violence. We must deploy guards to ensure the public's safety and security. Both groups have proven to be dangerous, but one is clearly the instigator. Where should we focus our efforts?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Bright Lights in a Dark World

options.text: Ask [character] to share the burden of building this new monument.
Shoulder the entire expense of the new monument and credit [character] as being one of the inspirations behind the idea.
At present, we simply lack the resources to do this idea justice.

events.text: The world is a cold, dark, cruel place. Both your People and the [tribe], however, seem to have been blessed. It is a phrase on everyone's lips. You and [character] are different in a great many ways, but in what is perhaps the most important way, the two of you are the same. You both serve as shining beacons of hope and inspiration for your People. That two very different leaders have emerged at the same moment in history, both serving as lights to push back against the darkness, is a heartening sign indeed, and it speaks of great things to come. You and [character] have had many a late night conversation about the future of your two Realms, and on more than one occasion, the subject of building a monument of hope and prosperity has come up. It is a compelling idea, but also, it would be frightfully expensive. What do you wish to do, regarding this opportunity?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Brothers in Arms

options.text: This alliance is crucial for our survival.
We cannot commit to the [tribe] right now.

requirements.label: Famous / Orator
tip: The leader must have one of: Famous; Orator

options.text: I will convince our soldiers with a fiery speech.

events.text: A pair of scarred and grizzled [tribe] warriors appear in court with a decree from [character]. It is an offer of aid during this time of warfare and strife. [character] wishes to form an alliance to ensure our victory in the current conflict. Despite this promise of reinforcements, our [rival] soldiers openly dislike the thought of fighting alongside barbarians.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Brought Near by Greed

options.text: More, I want more!
It might be costly, but I do look good.
Maybe our decadence has gone rather too far.

events.text: [rival] has been exporting an incredible amount of goods, which the people of [rival] have been eagerly buying, creating even more demand for the sought after foreign luxuries. [character] complains that the trade efforts with such distant lands are a waste, requiring an incredible amount of labor to move the frivolous goods. As he has written in a scathing attack, “Thus is [rival] brought near: by greed, and people’s decadent need to follow fashion.”

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Budding Connections

options.text: Investing in the future security of the Realm is always a good thing.
Encourage them to continue training together, but do not formally invite [character] to Court.

events.text: [character] knows he will lead one day, and has been quietly developing friendships, contacts and connections on his own that will help him greatly over the longer term. In recent months, he has been spending increasing amounts of time training with [character] of the [tribe]. It occurs to you that you could formalize that relationship, bringing [character] into the fold officially, which would help you and help your heir longer term.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Building Better Governors

options.text: I shall select Governor [character] for training.
Let us train Governor [character].
We should train Governor [character].
Although this is an excellent idea, it is one we can ill afford at present.

events.text: Your governors could serve your interests better with instruction, but instruction comes at a cost. While it would be impractical to bring all of your governors together for training, one among their number could be selected periodically. Who will you choose, if anyone?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: By Caste and Clan

options.text: Gift the Brahmins land around the capital.
Let the [family] use their own lands.
Refuse to grant the land.

events.text: The [religion] [family] Family have brought a proposal to gift the Brahmins with land to settle. The priestly caste has steadily been increasing in prestige, especially after the spread of a recent text emphasized their dominant position in society. The support of such a prominent family shows their importance, which gifts of land are likely to consolidate. Will the court support this decree?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: By the Numbers

rewards.text: Begin project: Office of Efficient Taxation

options.text: Let us model the taxation system of [city] after that used by the [tribe]. It will be expensive to set up initially, but should yield excellent dividends in the long run.
It's a novel idea, to be sure, but not one we can afford in the here and now.

events.text: You and [character] have a lot in common, but chief among them is that you both believe your People should be carefully and closely managed. A well-run Kingdom doesn't happen by accident, after all. It is an act of will. It takes discipline. [character] gets that. One evening, as you share a meal together talking, [character] brings up the topic of taxation. You're impressed by the way he handles the issue. The level of organization of his tax collectors goes far beyond anything you're currently doing and you sense an opportunity...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Caravan Attack

options.text: Punish those involved in this disgraceful act.
Both groups must share responsibility for this crime.
It was a terrible mistake and will not happen again.

events.text: A small caravan of [tribe] travelers has been attacked in a market in [city]. Members of the angry mob spat on the [tribe], hurled stones, and pulled them from their wagons to be beaten in the dirt. No sooner has the dust settled than a message arrives from [character]. "We are not on good terms, but we hope this does not prevent you from finding justice for our people. This transgression cannot be tolerated."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Caravan of Love

options.text: Let the heirs have their harmless fun.
They must stay focused on their responsibilities.
Express our concerns to [character].

events.text: A caravan of [rival] performers makes a stop in [city] to celebrate the promising relations between our nations. Among the troupe is [character], heir to the [rival] throne. Throughout the evening, you notice him catching the eye of your heir, [character]. The two young people appear to be getting along well... which may be a cause for concern.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Cave of Patriarchs

options.text: Let him purchase the land in perpetuity.
Rent him the space, but keep ownership.

events.text: The mysterious [religion] prophet Moses has suffered a grave loss. His wife has died, and he wishes to buy royal land on which to build a tomb, but it would be more beneficial to us for him to pay annual rent. Moses' followers hang on his every word. To resist his wishes may incur their wrath.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Chance Discovery

options.text: We shall translate it at once, but keep the findings to ourselves, refusing to share the fruits of the discovery with the [tribe]
Translate the scroll and share the wisdom it contains with [character]

events.text: Riders approach unexpectedly from the lands of the [tribe]. Their leader, [character] is breathless and flush with excitement. "Recent rains caused a mudslide that revealed a cave entrance in our territory. Some of my People ventured inside to explore it and found this..." He hands you a bone scroll case, its seal still intact. "Given your inquisitive nature, my first thought was to bring it here to see if you could tell us what wisdom it might contain." You can barely conceal your excitement. How will you respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Chancellor Candidates

options.text: Choose [character].
Choose [character].
I will make my own decisions!

events.text: We have no Chancellor to manage our royal affairs. In response, both the [family] and [family] families have suggested candidates for the position. Remember. Whomever we choose will possess great influence, and his or her family will reap the rewards.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: City on the Brink

options.text: Host a massive military parade in [city]!
Reduce taxes to ease the city's burden.
Let [character] deal with these problems.

events.text: [character] wishes to discuss the rumblings of rebellion in [city], where his people have become increasingly discontent. Inhabitants are burning effigies and defacing paintings with your likeness. Drastic measures must be taken. [character] suggests a city-wide celebration, but a reduction of the city's taxes could also help.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Clearing His Debt

options.text: There is no need for repayment, it was for a friend!

events.text: [character] approaches you about clearing the debt that he owes you. He understands that you were a great supporter in his time of need, but now it is time to even the scales. What gift shall we accept to resolve this matter?

events.author: Andy Auseon
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Clemency

options.text: Political rivals should not be silenced.
This is an issue for the [city] courts.
Negotiate a political exile to save face.

events.text: [character], Governor of [city], has plans to execute an individual that he claims is leading local rebellions. However, many in [city] believe this man to be innocent, and that [character] sees him as a rival. The accused's supporters have asked us to intervene on his behalf. We have the power to override the order of execution, but it would certainly offend the city's leadership.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Contest of Politics

options.text: I will go and defend it myself.
Hire a master orator to speak on our behalf.
Refuse to subject our policies to debate.

events.text: The [family] family stages a contest of politics, discussing the merits of our highly centralized state. They request that the court send a royal scholar to defend the status quo. Despite appearances, the [family] assure us that their interest in the matter is purely theoretical. What will you do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Courtly Commissions

options.text: Of course, the court artists are available to all.
No, they will remain in the capital.

events.text: There is a divide in the artistic styles of [rival]. The royal commissions are statues carved from stone, while in many other cities, most craftsmen still work in wood and clay. [character] has made a request that the artisans take the time to teach their methods to other artists throughout [rival]. This undertaking would push [rival] into a new age of culture, although would take up most of the royal artists’ time.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Crime and Punishment

options.text: [character] has led the city astray and will be held responsible.
The merchants will pay fines to repay the people of [city].
Extend [character] an offer of clemency, for a price.

events.text: [character] has been brought before the courts, charged with leading a group of traders systematically increasing the prices of goods coming into [city] in order to increase their own profits. Nearly all of the merchants of the city were involved in the racket, although [character] has been singled out as the leader. The [religion] magistrates of the city suggest the harshest punishments, as such conspiracy causes systematic damage to the lives of all people.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Crisis on the Border

options.text: Send them whatever food they need in order to get them through the current crisis.
Send food yes, but engineer a trade. They have warriors of renown and we could use them to bolster our own ranks.
Sadly, we are in no position to help them. Leave them to their own devices.

events.text: Recently, a confluence of events has occurred that gives your heir, [character] a chance to shine. You're sick. Too sick to meet with delegates from your neighbors, and a crisis has occurred in the lands of the [tribe]. Crop failure has threatened the lives of thousands, and they need help now. How will [character] respond?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Cruel Summer

options.text: Not only should we build them for public display, I shall give [character] his favorite as a gift!
Although it's a tempting idea, [character] and I will content ourselves with late night conversations about such devices.

events.text: You spend a lot of time thinking of new and creative ways to torture people. It's a hobby of yours and a thing you have in common with [character]. In fact, the two of you have come up with so many conjectural devices, you'd be hard pressed to select a favorite. Would it be the "Lama Drama" machine that slowly pulls subjects apart? Covering a hapless victim in honey and feed, then letting a score of ravenous chickens loose to work their magic, or perhaps that odd looking contraption [character] sketched out called the "Pulley-Driven Prisoner Dicer and Maligner?" Either way, it occurs to you that it might be fun to have your engineers actually build them and put them on display as a means of keeping the annoying heads of your vassal families in line. It would be expensive, to be sure, but it could be fun, or at least "fun," and there's value in that too. What do you want to do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Culinary Escapades

options.text: Have the cook captured and secreted into our kitchens.
Lavish praise on the food then have the cook ‘disappear’.
Have our cooks attempt to recreate the dishes.
Our household’s talents lie elsewhere.

events.text: Society gossip has it that the [family] family has engaged a cook of some rare talent. They are creating the most amazing culinary creations that are setting their parties afire! We cannot have the [family]’s parties eclipsing our own; our honor is at stake!

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Darkened Moon

options.text: This is a sign we will have fortune in battle.
Our wise men say it is a natural occurrence.
Give offerings to the gods, and pray for daylight.

events.text: On a still night, the moon moves into the shadow of the earth. The only light reaching its surface glows an ominous, bloody red. Our soldiers believe this to be an ill omen, and they express anxiety about their fortune in coming battles. What shall we tell your officers?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Death in the Family

options.text: No, he knew the risks.
Yes, I will admit my failings and honor him.

events.text: Your brother [character] blames you for the death of his son, who was killed in a skirmish with barbarians. He demands a public admission that mistakes were made, and he wants a feast thrown in [character]'s honor.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Debt Repaid

options.text: That works for me, we could always use more talent at Court.
I would not feel right about essentially making a hostage of one of your kin, and no matter how we dress it up, that's what it would feel like to me.

events.text: [character] approaches you one day as you're leaving Court. "I have not forgotten that I owe you a favor," he says. "Would you consider my debt settled if I placed [character] in your service as a Court Merchant?"

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Decadence

options.text: Each citizen must make a sacrifice at the temple!
Our high priests do not need encouragement.

events.text: The [family] Clerics worry that the city of [city] has grown decadent, the citizens reveling in luxurious debauchery and even abandoning their gods. They foresee doom, and demand offerings and sacrifices. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Deliverance

options.text: I wish to be among the saved.
[rival] is not beholden to the gods.

events.text: In a fiery oration, [character] labels every member of the court - and every [rival] subject - as a "sinner" in need of spiritual deliverance. His family, the [family], have become fiercer in their belief that the world is composed of two separate groups: the sinners and the saved. We may wish to ascribe to his beliefs, no matter what the cost.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Demand for Autonomy

options.text: The crown relinquishes our control of the city.
We cannot risk the [family] gaining more power.

events.text: Followers of the [family] Family have taken to the streets of [city] in the hundreds, protesting against collapsing roads and poor supplies in the city. Your advisers suspect that this is the result of a concentrated propaganda effort by the [family] to weaken your hold in the city. It would be a bold move, but they suggest that giving the family completely autonomous rule of the city could go a long way to repairing relations with them. Shall the [family] rule [city] alone?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Designs on the Throne

options.text: No, we do not want to sow further distrust.
Yes, we must uncover any harmful plots.
No need, an enemy of [character] has provided ample evidence of his guilt.

events.text: [character] believes that [character] and the [family] family have designs on the throne. However, he cannot prove his suspicions without evidence. He would like to approach several of his agents within the [family] to gather more information. Shall we permit an investigation?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Dishonor Our Ancestors

options.text: Ignore the petulant whelp.
[character] is right, I have brought dishonor to [rival].
Who dares order [character]!
Enough questioning my authority.

requirements.label: Schemer / Corrupt
tip: The leader must have one of: Schemer; Corrupt

options.text: Slander [character] as illegitimate.

events.text: "This shameful reign must end!" [character]'s words ring out, as he confronts you in front of your entire inner circle. "My father would be outraged at how far [rival] has fallen." The mention of our beloved [character] reminds many in the court of his glorious rule. "Step down from the throne," advises [character], "and I will not be forced to make you."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Dreams of Home

options.text: Yes, there is still so much to learn...
No, I will return to [rival] at long last.

events.text: You have been exploring for years... Now, when the sun dims on the horizon, you cannot help but think of home. Perhaps it is time to return to [city]. Will you continue on your voyages of discovery?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Earl Grey, Hot

options.text: Yes, let's take control of the tea, but let's be smart about it, and pay the [family] a fair price.
Let us not only take control of the supply of tea, but of the talented merchant who introduced it to our realm.
Alas, no. We are in no position to take advantage of this opportunity.

events.text: The Court has been all abuzz about the exploits of [character]. It seems that during his travels, he discovered a wonderful new hot drink and now, everybody who's anybody wants to try some and [character] himself has become something of a celebrity. Having tried some of this new drink yourself recently, you definitely understand the appeal. It occurs to you that you could easily gain a monopoly over the drink, and that perhaps you should...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Earthquake

options.text: We must work harder to please the gods.
Our engineering needs improvement.
It is coincidence, and there is nothing we can do.

events.text: All across [city], a violent shaking rocks buildings and jostles temples, sending debris into the streets. Terrified people huddle in caves and shrines, hoping to stay safe from the aftermath. This natural disaster could only mean one thing...

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Economic Focus

options.text: Now is the perfect time to direct civic resources toward building a brighter future.
Let us divert military resources to bolstering our economy.
We shall stay our current course. Ignore these whimperings from Court. Our current leadership is fine.

events.text: With your realm growing nicely, there are those in your Court who are pushing for a greater economic focus. It would be easy enough to find a merchant of note to add, if you were inclined to do so.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Educating Our Women

options.text: Education is provided to all people, equally.
We should keep our conservative ways to please the elderly and the elites.

events.text: Many of the nation's elderly and elites are starting to voice concerns about educating women to be their equals. They want us to put a limit to how much education we can allow our women.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Embracing Change

options.text: I don't see how we can ignore the opportunity.
As attractive as it sounds, we simply don't have the resources to spare.

events.text: Your People, like all People, have traditions. Established ways of doing things. Unfortunately, "the way it's always been done" isn't always the best or most efficient. As you've continued to establish yourself in these new lands, you've been watching the way the [tribe] go about the business of harvesting food from the ground, from animals, and extracting metals from the earth. Their methods are somewhat different from yours, and frankly, better. It occured to you that if you could convince the tribal elders to allow your People to study their methods, you could create a series of hybrid techniques that gave you the best of both worlds and made all of your mines, farms and pastures more productive on the whole. It took some doing, but you've finally convinced [character] to send some of his people to your lands so you can learn from them. Paying for their upkeep will be a daunting expense but in the long run, the project could pay handsome dividends. What say you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Encore

options.text: Welcome [character] return.
There is no longer a place for him in the court of [rival].
I think not.

events.text: A quiet life is what you make of it, bringing fulfillment and peace to those who find meaning in the chance to enjoy the quieter moments of life. [character] is bored. Dramatically re-appearing in the palace without warning, he has decided that it is time to return to take an active part in [rival].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Epic Poetry

options.text: To recite her poems for the public.
To teach me what she knows.
To enter the court's service.

events.text: A young poetess versed in the art of reciting epics has appeared in court, asking for our patronage. What shall we tell her?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Exploration

options.text: Let us press forward, for the best is yet to come!
This would offend the gods, and bring destruction upon our heads.

events.text: Not a full moon passes without news of fascinating discoveries reaching our court. Your scouts bring reports from distant lands and civilizations, while your scholars research and debate, inventing at a rapid pace. Surely, the universe has never revealed its mysteries to us as swiftly as it does now. We must boldly go where none have dared!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Nobility

options.text: Does the cow argue with the lion?
We need more soldiers, not farmers. Conscript both nobles and serfs!
Maintain order and justice through the law.

events.text: Tens of thousands of serfs work the land. Some say they even number in the hundreds of thousands by now, a greater number than at any time in your nation's history. This system has become the backbone of our economy, leading to great prosperity and solving national hunger. However, the nobles think themselves above the serfs and act as such. What shall be our stance on this matter?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Exploring the Wonders of the World

options.text: Let us visit the wondrous City of [city]!
The wise man stays at home.

events.text: Although a powerful monarch, you keenly feel your ignorance of the great Wonders of the World. Every leader should know of the world's great architectural achievements, and you are eager to set out and explore them. You've heard extraordinary tales of <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_CITY_PYRAMIDS>Pyramids<p=SUBJECT_CITY_GREAT_ZIGGURAT>Great Ziggurat<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ORACLE>Oracle<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HANGING_GARDENS>Hanging Gardens<p=SUBJECT_CITY_NECROPOLIS>Necropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ISHTAR_GATE>Ishtar Gate<p=SUBJECT_CITY_LIGHTHOUSE>Lighthouse<p=SUBJECT_CITY_APADANA>Apadana<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MAUSOLEUM>Mausoleum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ACROPOLIS>Acropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_COLOSSUS>Colossus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MUSAEUM>Musaeum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CIRCUS_MAXIMUS>Circus Maximus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_PANTHEON>Pantheon<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HAGIA_SOPHIA>Hagia Sophia<p=SUBJECT_CITY_VIA_RECTA_SOUK>Via Recta Souk<else>Pyramids<end> in the city of [city]. Each day, you feel ever more drawn to the thought of visiting the city. It is your only distraction from the mundanity of palace duties. Shall you set out on an adventure to see <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_CITY_PYRAMIDS>Pyramids<p=SUBJECT_CITY_GREAT_ZIGGURAT>Great Ziggurat<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ORACLE>Oracle<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HANGING_GARDENS>Hanging Gardens<p=SUBJECT_CITY_NECROPOLIS>Necropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ISHTAR_GATE>Ishtar Gate<p=SUBJECT_CITY_LIGHTHOUSE>Lighthouse<p=SUBJECT_CITY_APADANA>Apadana<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MAUSOLEUM>Mausoleum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ACROPOLIS>Acropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_COLOSSUS>Colossus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MUSAEUM>Musaeum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CIRCUS_MAXIMUS>Circus Maximus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_PANTHEON>Pantheon<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HAGIA_SOPHIA>Hagia Sophia<p=SUBJECT_CITY_VIA_RECTA_SOUK>Via Recta Souk<else>Pyramids<end>?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Extremist Laws

options.text: Religion and government should not mix.
I will release the priests.
The gods have chosen me to rule.

events.text: After the arrest of zealous [religion] priests, some question our decision to enact laws that encourage religious extremism. The court summons the most powerful leaders of [religion] to ask for their wisdom in improving the government. Sadly, discussions fail. "We will not hinder the will of the gods," explains the high priest.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: False Gossip

options.text: Pay to put his suspicions to rest.
Lead him astray with false information.
I will not play along with [character].

events.text: Rumors suggest that [character] has been asking questions and probing into your personal affairs. We should put any false gossip to rest as soon as possible, lest our rivals seek to profit from them. What shall we do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Family Discontent

options.text: Exile [character] for treason.
Bring [character] into your confidence.
Hold a feast for noble families.
Convince nobles that our rule benefits everyone.

events.text: In a rallying cry to your enemies on the court, [character] demands our removal. He believes that the royal family has ruled [rival] for too long, causing the inevitable decay of society. Rebels are said to be surrounding the palace at this very moment. What do you command?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Games

options.text: We will host the [family]'s games.
They ask for far too much.

events.text: A messenger arrives with news that the [family] family is displeased with your lack of support. They demand that the court plan and host a week of expensive athletic games in their honor. How shall we respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Family Governor

options.text: Appoint [character] as governor.
Refuse the proposal.

events.text: [character] has sought a meeting to discuss the governorship of [city]. The [title] argues that as the seat of the [family] family, it is only right that a [family] should lead the city. [character] suggests [character] as an ideal candidate. Will you accept his preferred governor?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Partisans

options.text: Crush these rebels without mercy.
Make key charitable donations and promise a better future.

events.text: Smoke fills the skies over [city]! Partisans supporting the disgruntled [family] family have risen against you in the streets. They threaten to put the whole city to the torch. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Quarrel

options.text: Leave the lovers to their affair, and let them return.
Give [character] permission to pursue them.
Send troops to bring them back.

events.text: Drama consumes the court. [character] has run away with [character], leaving their families behind. Now his husband, [character], demands that we organize an expedition to pursue [character], kill him and return [character]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Family Retreat

options.text: Imprison [character] as a warning.
Their relationship means nothing.
I will earn their trust and then strike.

events.text: This is the second year that the [family] and [family] Family have spent the summer months together at a lavish estate in the hills. Their cooperation in court continues to strengthen, diminishing your authority. What happens at these private gatherings? What are the [family] and [family] plotting?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Famine Relief

options.text: They need help, and we are in a position to provide it. It's as simple as that.
We should provide aid, absolutely, but it needs to be reciprocal.
Sorry, no. This is not our problem.

events.text: Reports have reached your ear that the crops of the [tribe] have failed this year and the tribe is in dire straits. While tragic, this presents us with a potential opportunity. How shall we respond?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Fates and Fortunes

options.text: This could definitely work to our advantage.
Intriguing idea or not, it's just not something we can afford to do at present.

events.text: Your days at Court are filled with hearing a wide range of petitions and deciding people's fates. Much of the time, the people who come before you and their various pleadings are fairly predictable. You do love it though, when you get a genuine surprise, and on this day, you have definitely received one. A man calling himself [character] appears before you with a most intriguing proposition. "Majesty, I am primarily interested in trade. In bettering myself and improving the lot of my family by way of commerce. This stands in stark contrast to the general bent of my People, who would much rather fight and stuff their faces." You nod in understanding. "If I may come straight to the point, I find myself increasingly at odds with my own kind. Constant warfare is not the way forward. If you would agree to grant my tribe a sum of gold to formally release me, I would happily sever ties with my People and serve you." An intriguing notion indeed...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Favorite Vassal

options.text: Yes, but only if it does not cost much.
No, this is not our responsibility.

events.text: Feeling entitled, the [family] family has gotten into the habit of asking special gifts and favors of us. Now they wish to borrow money to cover losses in their latest trade debacle. What do we tell them?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fear of the Other

options.text: I must not shrink from what must be done.
The people of [city] must control themselves... or face the lash.
We must find another way to fix this unrest.
Pay local scholars to help the [tribe] assimilate.

events.text: [character] has been assaulted on the streets of [city], the latest in a series of attacks against [tribe] in [city]. Bitterness against the [tribe] population has been growing. Your noted rival, [character], addresses the court. "The [rival] people have had enough of this [tribe] threat. We must remove the foreign infestation." He is aware of your difficulty with this issue, as your husband is [tribe].

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Ferocity

options.text: We should build a training pit and throw our new recruits in with wild dogs to teach them to let their most ferocious selves come to the fore.
While I would dearly love to watch my soldiers learn to live and fight as [character] do, we simply cannot afford the expense right now.

events.text: [character] is a leader after your own heart. With ferocity and intensity burning in his eyes, he reminds you of, well...you. That's probably why the two of you have begun spending increasing amounts of time together. It occurs to you during one of those visits that ferocity, like anything else, is a skill that can be taught, and perhaps it should be. Perhaps it should be...

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Fieldcraft - Herbal Medicine

rewards.text: Begin project: Patronage of the Healing Gods

options.text: We can't afford not to. This skill is far too important, and [character] deserves credit for inspiring the idea.
It's a spectacular idea, but we just aren't in a position to implement it. Of course that doesn't mean that [character] and I can't continue to hone our skills together!

events.text: You and [character] have been spending a lot of time together recently, mostly as a result of your shared interest in herbalism. You've talked more than once about the idea of establishing a formal training program for your troops. Teach them fieldcraft and the basics of using herbal medicine and they should be more effective in the field. It's an intriguing idea, to say the least. The big question is, can you afford it?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Folk Tales

options.text: Offer yourself as a sacrifice.
Send one of your servants to take your place.
Refuse to partake in this ritual.

events.text: [character] rasping breath shudders uneasily through the room, a clear sign that your spouse is close to death. Sensing that you are losing hope, [character] comes to you with a local folk tale. It speaks of an adventure where the hero walks into death to save his love. [character] has studied the stories and is ready to perform the ritual used by the hero, but there is a cost. It requires that the hero is sacrificed so he can enter the lands of the dead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Forbidden Knowledge

options.text: Host the sages and hear their teachings.
We will start as allies to build trust.
Barbarians have nothing to teach us.
Publically condemn the tribe, but meet with them in secret.

events.text: Our scientists rave about the [tribe], specifically the tribe's cult of mystics known as the Tree Seers. They believe we should forge an alliance with the [tribe] to harness their forbidden knowledge. The question is whether we can trust the Tree Seers and their savage brethren?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Forced Deportations

options.text: Prepare the forced deportation plan.
That is no way to treat our loyal subjects.

events.text: The great soldier, [character], approaches the court with a controversial plan: forced deportations. He believes that a hostile foreign element is inspiring revolts against the nation. The plan would be effective in quelling rebellion. However, it would anger the populace, and it may offend the [family] family, many of whom originate from other lands.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Foreign Advocate on the Court

options.text: I want to improve diplomatic relations with the [rival] through a Peace mission.
This is not the way I wish to conduct diplomacy.

events.text: [character], a [rival] member of our court, is anxious to expand our diplomatic relationships with his people. He wants us to send [character] on a Player Peace Mission to the [rival]. Shall we approve of his plan to propose a Peace deal?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Foreign Advocate on the Court

options.text: I would like to help establish diplomatic relations through a Trade Mission.
This is not the way I wish to conduct diplomacy.

events.text: [character], a [rival] member of our court, is anxious to expand our diplomatic relationships with his people. He wants us to send [character] on a Trade Mission to the [rival]. Shall we approve of his plan to execute a Trade Mission?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Foreign Fighters

options.text: A larger army is the highest priority.
This would set a dangerous precedent.
We have nothing to fear from the outside.

events.text: After much consideration, military advisor [character] proposes incorporating fighters from conquered nations into our army. He believes this action would swell our ranks considerably. While the idea shows promise, our noble families may not approve.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Forest Fire

options.text: Nothing. Nature can be cruel.
Scour the area for potential fires.

events.text: Smoke obscures the horizon near [city]! A blaze has broken out in a nearby clearing and threatens to engulf the entire forest. What should the people do?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Fortune Favors

options.text: Lend [character] your ministers and get his assistance improving the day to day conditions of the people of [city].
Help [character] feed his people in exchange for the wisdom of the elders of the [tribe].
Pour resources into helping [character], asking nothing in return.
Do nothing.

events.text: In recent months, you and [character] have become something of brothers in arms, often riding out on hunts together, training your troops with [tribe] War Bands, and of course, drinking and feasting together. There's something calming about being in the presence of bold, likeminded men and women. It makes you feel as though you can accomplish most anything. You and [character] have outlined a number of possible initiatives you could pursue jointly, and now seems like as good a time as any to sieze upon one and run with it. Fortune, after all, does favor the bold. What should the two of you focus on?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Forty Year Celebrations

options.text: I am the greatest ruler ever! Order parades, feasts, gladiatorial combats, and lots of feasting!
My many triumphs and accomplishments shall be inscribed upon a mighty obelisk for all to admire.
A humble celebration may be in order, however the improvement of the Nation is reward enough.

events.text: It has been forty years since you assumed rule of [rival]. Your council proposes the nation celebrate your reign in grand style.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Freed Slave

options.text: His words have convinced me, [rival] will no longer permit slavery.
[character] needs to understand the way of things.

events.text: The philosopher [character] describes the indignities of Slavery from the point of view of one who had endured them. He is now freed and inspiring a call for abolishing Slavery.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Friends in Low Places

options.text: Hire the warrior to provide training to [character].
Reward the tribe as a whole.
Send a polite thank you note, acknowledging the action, but nothing more.

events.text: One day, while out riding, [character] is attacked by a pack of ravenous wolves. He would have died if not for the timely intervention of [tribe] warrior. This presents a rare opportunity. How should we respond?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: From One Commander To Another

options.text: This is an opportunity too good to ignore.
As tempting as the offer is, we lack the resources to take advantage of it at present.

events.text: [character] is a leader after your own heart. The two of you are kindred spirits and he has been spending increasing amounts of time in your Court, whenever you can spare the time to get together. It's good to stay in such close contact with your peers, and given your similar outlook on life and the world, it can sometimes pay unexpected dividends as well. Recently, such an opportunity has arisen, with [character] offering to provide training to some of your troops if you will but maintain his officers while they're doing so. What say you?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: From One Ranger to Another

options.text: Work with [character] to teach our woodsmen how to get more out of the forest.
It's one of those ideas that sounds good to the ear, but in practice, would be frustratingly difficult. Let's go for another ride instead!

events.text: You and [character] are both hale and hearty and share a love of the outdoors. At this point, you've probably spent as much time wandering the wilds together as you have actually running your Kingdom. One thing you've learned from the experience is that the forest has much to teach those willing to listen and learn. Lessons that can be applied both militarily and economically. It occurs to you that your woodsmen could learn a thing or two from both you and [character].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: From on High

options.text: [character] is right. I have been blinded by power.
You have angered me, and so, the gods.
I will teach him how to rule from on high.

events.text: Somehow, the heir, [character], manages to get past your vicious elite guard and present himself before the throne. "A ruler should be beloved, not feared," he says. "Yet your subjects tremble in terror. They believe you are the unfeeling herald of the gods." Kneeling at your feet, he beseeches you. "Please, your grace, we must fix [rival] before it is too late."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fuming Priests

options.text: Save souls first, and then educate them.
We must serve all people, not only the faithful.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: I will remind them that truth is knowledge.

events.text: Murmurs of discontent hover over the court, as members of the [religion] church fume. The [religion] believe we have hindered their cause by prioritizing education over salvation. Our laws promoting public literacy divert funds that could be used by the church. They wish to know what we plan to do about this injustice.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Gem Seekers

options.text: It is a reasonable trade.
They may have what they desire.
No, we are saving these gems.

events.text: Members of the cultured [family] family are seeking to acquire fine gems for their private collection. Rumors suggest that they hope to receive some of the court's regalia as a gift. Do the [family] deserve our special attention?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Gods and Monsters

options.text: We can learn from these [religion] stories.
It is better to put our faith in science.

events.text: The [religion] beliefs of the [family] family have taken on a life of their own. Tales of gods, heroes, and monsters are commonplace with worshipers of [religion] and are now being taught in the temples. The [family] have encouraged the court to adopt these stories as part of our national culture.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Got Your Nose!

options.text: Laugh.
Cry.
My revenge shall be swift and silent.

events.text: In an attempt to entertain you, [character] has stolen your nose and refuses to give it back!

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Governor School

options.text: I shall select Governor [character] for training.
Let us train Governor [character].
We should train Governor [character].
Although this is an excellent idea, it is one we can ill afford at present.

events.text: Your governors could serve your interests better with proper instruction. It occurs to you that you could facilitate that education by making it a civic priority.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Governor Training

options.text: I shall select Governor [character] for training.
Let us train Governor [character].
We should train Governor [character].
Although this is an excellent idea, it is one we can ill afford at present.

events.text: You're not completely satisfied with the performance of your governors. Perhaps if you diverted a portion of your military's resources, you could provide some additional training?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Hands Tied

options.text: In this instance, [character] is correct to question me.
[rival] will not be defended by farmers and poets.
Issue a public reprimand of [character].

events.text: Emboldened by his allies on the court, the heir, [character], implores you to change the laws governing our armies. "Your strict codes of military conduct have tied our hands in battle. The toughest soldiers are those defending their lands and families." It is a stark reminder that you and your heir do not always agree.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Harsh Rule

options.text: Arrest any dissenters that you can catch.
Bribe influential citizens to keep the calm.
