Convince them it is for their own good.

events.text: While your despotic rule has quelled unrest, some citizens still grumble. We must remain vigilant. How shall we address their concerns?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Heated Rivalry

options.text: Refuse to abandon support for [character].
Acquiesce, and throw [character] in a cell.

events.text: The [family] family has gained significant influence over your affairs, even developing a rivalry with your heir, [character]. Eventually, tensions come to a head and the [family] nobles demand that you imprison [character] for false crimes. Do you alienate your allies, or do you turn on your heir?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Heavenly Mechanism

options.text: Give him what is needed to build the device.
We could use such a brilliant mind on the court.

events.text: A scientist from Aigilia visits the court to explain a marvelous device he has designed. It is an impressive system of gears, arranged in a particular pattern that is striking to the eye, with handles and arrows attached to the gears. The device, as the scientist explains, can calculate with ease figures that challenge the wisest scholar, such as when the Sun gets blotted in an eclipse or when the Pleiades rise in the sky. The court is very impressed by such a design and has already learned a lot from the drawings presented. Unfortunately, the scientist is not as resourceful as he is brilliant - he lacks the resources to actually build his device, which would surely improve our understanding of the heavens.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Heir Intent

options.text: We must consolidate power.
[character] is not the king yet.
I will ply him with fine wine.

events.text: At a court celebration, the heir, [character], corners you alone on an overlook. With a view of the capital below, he blusters against the current division of power. "All power should flow from the throne. The noble families must answer to one ruler." He claims to lead a faction intent on changing the laws. "If you do not," he says, "I most certainly will."

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Heroes of Two Realms

options.text: Arrange a great hunt, followed by a triumphant parade through the streets of [city].
Leverage our collective fame to improve the readiness of our military.
Take advantage of our fame to improve the lives of our People.
As thrilling as it might be to do something together, now is simply not the time.

events.text: You and [character] couldn't be more different. The two of you are a study in contrasts and yet, you share one shining, important trait. You are both seen as heroes by your respective People. You both possess larger than life personalities, and it is this, more than anything, that has drawn you together. You delight in getting together whenever time permits and trading stories of your exploits, occasionally embellished by strong drink. The notion that the two of you should do something together has come up more than once, and it's something that has always appealed to you, but what? A few possibilities come to mind:

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Heroes of the Blood Pit

options.text: Honor and glory for myself, of course.
Let [character] win, and bet on him.
Convince [character] to drink with you, rather than fighting, and add the winner to your court.

events.text: You and [character] have been spending increasing amounts of time in the Blood Pits of [city]. A crude arena built by the commoners of that city where anyone can pay to fight. The competition is always fierce and the battles bloody, but both you and [character] have won honor and glory. Although you are the better warrior overall, [character] is no slouch, and he has gotten the better of you a few times. There's another match coming up. If you push yourself, victory is a foregone conclusion. What's your plan?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Hidden Scrolls

options.text: I do not wish to disappoint [character].
Politics must be free of emotion.

events.text: Stopping by your son's chamber for a visit, you discover a cache of scrolls in a compartment behind his bed. The writings are critical of the current authoritarian policies of the government, especially your strict codes of law. It appears that [character] has been indoctrinated into a passionate resistance movement.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Holy Figures

options.text: It is right to honor our ancestors.
They should worship me instead.

events.text: Statues of deceased members of the [family] family have started appearing in [religion] places of worship. It appears that the [family] have begun to worship their ancestors as holy figures. This practice may be useful if adopted across all [rival].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Honor Guard

options.text: Choose the [family] champion.
Choose the [family] champion.
We should continue our search.

events.text: A position in your personal honor guard has become available. Rival candidates from the [family] and [family] families have both come forward to petition for the opening. Which shall we choose?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Horse Traders

options.text: Accept the offered deal.
Request their coin instead.
Turn them away.

events.text: It is said that the [rival] have so many horses that they can only be counted by the valley-full. In addition to their use in war, the horses are also a valuable source of trade, though the once nomadic people are testy to those who spurn them. Rumors of Jade have attracted merchants from [rival], seeking to trade Horse for the rare material.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Hostages

options.text: Yes! Let us buy his freedom and return him to his people to gain political advantage.
Intriguing. And we could always use a new, capable person at Court.
As tempting as the offer is, it is something we cannot presently afford.

events.text: It is a most unusual day at Court. [character] arrives unexpectedly, and with a proposition and a figure trailing behind him in chains. "Recently, we captured [character] as he passed through our territory. Given that you have dealt fairly with us in the past, we offer you his life, if you want it." How will you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Household Troubles

options.text: As a minister he will have access to all of the city records.
Refuse [character] and have him focus on resting.

events.text: Your husband [character] expresses his concern one morning; many of his servants and staff are ill, and a pregnant serving girl has miscarried. You are expressing concern when he falls to the floor, shaking and feverish. His recently hired head of staff helps you to look after him until help arrives. Later [character] tells you that he believes the drinking water from the palace well is at fault. He asks that you promote his head of staff [character] to a prominent position to help look into the matter.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: I Have a Little List

options.text: Add the name.
No, I draw the line at my own enemies.

events.text: Your ally [character] has asked for his own enemy [character] to be added to the next list of proscriptions. It is clear that [character] is no enemy of [rival], but [character] support would certainly be useful. Would [character] really be missed?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Idle Hands

options.text: We shall strive to provide some amusement.

events.text: Travellers bring disturbing news. The [tribe] are preparing for war against us. No one can say why this is happening. It seems that [character] has simply grown bored with peace.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Impatience

options.text: I must escape this stupor and do my duty.
Do not question my methods, or my mandate.
[character] has gone too far in his criticism.

events.text: You have skipped on attending the court's debates for days, and now members of the court have finally lost their patience. Led by [character] of house [family], they come to your private chambers to complain about your listless style of governing. "It is time to show us your commitment," says [character]. "Or we will be forced to take matters into our own hands."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Improper Vassal

options.text: Gently remind the [family] of decorum.
Reprimand the [family] for their impropriety.
Let this slight go unpunished.

events.text: The [family] nobility has become overly familiar with you, to a degree that other families find unseemly. At a recent feast, the [family] leadership greets you informally and seats themselves first at the royal table. The other families turn to you to issue a rebuke. What will you do?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: In a Bind

options.text: We would be happy to assist, and will even pay to have [character] relocated.
We're glad to help, but you will have to bear the cost of getting him here.
I'm sorry, but no. Whatever he has done is your problem to deal with.

events.text: [character] comes to you unexpectedly, seeking a favor. "I need your assistance with a...let us say 'delicate' matter. [character] needs to disappear, lest my vassals find him and tear him limb from limb. He is a talented soldier, and I don't like the notion of parting with him, but also I don't want to see him murdered. Will you take him in?"

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In the Water

options.text: Send royal engineers to [city] to design a solution.
I refuse to push Governor [character] aside.
We must focus our efforts on healing [character].

events.text: Governor [character]'s sickness continues to be a mystery, but scientists in [city] believe they have discovered the cause: filthy gray water running from the streets into the city's water supply. Every day, the illness seems to spread to more households. With [character] incapacitated, it is up to us to step in and take control of [city]'s welfare. Unless we wish to stay out of a city's local affairs.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Independent City

options.text: Refuse to indulge the rabble.
Very well, let them rule themselves.
The people know my reign is ordained by the heavens, no usurpers will sway them.

events.text: Amidst growing discontent, the people of [city] have been becoming increasingly organized in their resistance to your rule. Headed by an elected council of elders, they have trained an independent militia and live by their own laws. A message has arrived from this council, asking that you recognize the city's independence. They promise to continue to swear fealty and to pay taxes, but beyond that the city will be out of your hands.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Inside Man

options.text: We must eject [character] from the court at once.
Take [character] into custody and deliver him to [rival].
Meddling in [rival] affairs will not be tolerated.

events.text: A message arrives from [character]. He has learned that your close advisor, [character], has been conspiring with radicals in [rival]. We must immediately recall [character] if we are to have any hope of maintaining good relations between [rival] and [rival]. "We were friends once," says the message. "Do not force my hand. [character] must go!"

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Irreparable Damage

options.text: Yes, we must invest more in [rival].
We cannot turn away from the world now.
Break up the sect and remove [character].

events.text: Our agents in [city] discover that [character], merchant of the court, has been meeting with a radical isolationist sect. This group is convinced that international trade is irreparably damaging the [rival] economy. Perhaps we should consider reviving labor and commerce here in [rival], instead of allowing foreign governments to reap the rewards.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Island Council

options.text: We should take every opportunity to improve relations.
[character] is not worth my time.
Something about this seems suspicious...

events.text: Using his foreign connections, [character] has arranged for a peaceful meeting with [character] to discuss the future of your nations. The council is scheduled to be held on a small island off the coast, a neutral territory for both parties. Shall we agree to this secretive meeting?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Job Opening

options.text: We can handle affairs without him.
A new advisor should be appointed.

events.text: [character] has had enough! After years of tolerating your open corruption, our Merchant has grown weary of covering up your incessant frauds. He and his family slip away in the dead of night, leaving a vacancy in the court.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Jugurtha

options.text: We must intervene to stop this upstart.
Numidia stands alone.

events.text: The [tribe] have been overtaken by a formidable ruler, [character], an illegitimate royal who seized the throne by force. The [tribe] Princes and rightful heirs have come to [rival] to seek your help. Despite initial attempts to ease the tension and divide the land between the claimants, [character] is soon threatening violence: Stay out of [tribe] affairs or face his wrath.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Killed In Cold Water

options.text: Sounds like the [family] had too much wine and a bad temper.
The plotting [family] must have tried to kill the man and get away with it.
Demons possessed them! Prayers and feasts in [city] will drive out the evil!
Both are clearly victims, and the killer is at large. That's a task for the city guard.

events.text: [city] is stunned by an apparent murder at the city's Baths 1. A [family] man and a [family] woman were found with their bruised faces down in the water, their belongings in disarray. The families are in uproar, but if you asked any two people what happened, you'd get three versions of events. And that's despite the total absence of any witnesses.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: King of the Field

options.text: [character] is a born ruler.
Continue on your way.

events.text: As you ride through the fields of [city], you pass by a group of children enacting a pitched battle, lining up in imaginary warfare and clashing together with happy shouts. As you watch the fighting unfold, you are impressed by the leader of one of the sides. Even after the battle is won, the other children still treat him with the utmost respect.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Land Dispute

options.text: We must respect the ancestral claim of the [family].
The [family] have made the land their own.
Do nothing... but watch for developments.
That land should belong to me.

events.text: The [family] and [family] families have engaged in a heated land dispute. The [family] claim they have an ancestral right to a particularly productive [family] estate, but the [family] deny the claims. Whose side shall we take?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Lands of Plenty

options.text: Let us collaborate on initiatives designed to make our two Peoples happier.
We should collaborate on initiatives that look to the future, exploring scientific mysteries.
As wonderful as these conversations are, we don't currently have the resources to bring them to light and life.

events.text: It has taken longer than you would have liked, but you've finally gotten your Realm working more or less as you envisioned. To be sure, there's still much to be done, but your People are prosperous and more often than not, thriving under your rule. The same can be said of [character], a like-minded individual who has led his people out of darkness and into a better future as well. It is a thing the two of you often discuss over tankards of ale when you find yourselves together. The question of how best to use the prosperity you both enjoy is a topic that comes up frequently, and two intriguing initiatives have emerged from those conversations. The question, then, is which of them might be worth pursuing in the here and now?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Law Change

options.text: Make the change.
Our answer is no.

events.text: Representatives of the [family] family arrive in court to make an appeal. They request that the [rival] government adopt a new law, [law], that favors their interests. How shall we respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Leading the Flock

options.text: He will lead you well.
Remember your place, I decide who governs this land.

events.text: One of the from [city] comes before your court. He says that the city is in need of guidance from a leader who will support the efforts of the [religion] faith, and boldly adds that [character] already has the backing of the [religion] leaders. Shall [character] be the new Governor of [city]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Legal Reforms

options.text: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.
When struck, turn the other cheek.

events.text: [city] has recently experienced a rash of blood feuds between individuals and families. An eye for an eye will soon make the whole city blind. A new code of justice must be drafted, or the violence in [city] will devolve into complete chaos. How shall we curb this alarming rise in vendettas?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Live and Let Dye

options.text: That sounds like nonsense, send him on his way.
We are persuaded and will provide a royal charter to sell his hair dye.

events.text: [character] arrives at court and claims that our women's custom of using a mixture of lead and sulphur to dye their hair causes health problems - headaches, miscarriages, seizures. He suggests they use his own harmless plant-based dye instead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Local Beliefs

options.text: Local festivals do no harm.
No. [city] is only the beginning.

events.text: [religion] festivals in [city] have grown in size and number. The religion has expanded so rapidly that it is no surprise when priests arrive in court to offer their blessing. They ask for something in return. "A movement must have the support of its ruler, not only its people."

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Local Brigands

options.text: Track and kill these outlaws.
We need our [unit] on military duty.

events.text: The commander of one of our [unit] formations has received numerous reports of raiders prowling the nation's roadways. He seeks the court's support to root out these villains and restore security. What is our response?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Locust Swarms

options.text: Send the people to the fields with nets and blankets!
We have offended the gods and must offer sacrifices!
Protect the Granaries!

events.text: Swarms of locust have formed in [city], stripping fields and damaging crops. There is potential for famine, as well as pestilence from the many rodents who are feeding on the insects.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Looking Outward

options.text: I will explore the world myself.
Dispatch our swiftest scouts.

events.text: We have decreed our desire to explore the limits of the known world and to establish contact with other nations. Now we must put these new laws into practice. How shall we proceed?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Looking for Answers

options.text: [rival] must be an enlightened people.
Your comments border on heresy.
Knowledge and faith can coexist.

events.text: "May I be truthful with you?" asks [character], wise minister to the court. "I fear that spirituality may be stunting our people. Once, we were a nation of learned men and women. Now, we are a scared flock looking to the heavens for answers." He is not the first to express this concern. Our faith may have come at the cost of an educated public.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Lost Integrity

options.text: Let them go. They are easily replaced.
We must restore our military's honor.
Tell them whatever it takes for them to stay.

events.text: Several generals, including [character], come before the throne to express their displeasure with the current state of the [rival] military. "We are expected to fight alongside children and old men. This is no way to conduct war." They pledge to retire their posts if no action to restore their integrity is taken.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Lost Relative

options.text: Invite [character] to a private audience.
Order the Spymaster to investigate [character].
Ignore [character] and he will go away.

events.text: Whispers in [city] tell of a mysterious arrival to the city, a man called [character] who claims to be a lost member of the royal family. [character]'s story has captured the heart of the people, and they seek to raise him up to his lost station. We should act quickly to get ahead of this news.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Lotus-Eaters

options.text: [rival] will not tolerate cultural decadence.
[character] must do a better job as governor.
I will visit [city] and lift the people's spirits.

events.text: [character], the governor of [city], expresses concerns with the current laws and how they are affecting his city. "My citizens are layabouts and deviants, sharing ideas, religions, and blood. They enjoy lives of wanton pleasure, but at what cost?" Is he right? Have we built a nation of coddled lotus-eaters?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Love is in the air

options.text: That's a lot to take in!

events.text: [character] has asked to speak with you in private. He leads you into a cosy nook and says, “[character], I have to tell you how I feel. You see, I could never resist a man with such <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>strong faith<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>great knowledge<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR>a way with words<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT>ability to understand and compromise<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER>great cunning<p=SUBJECT_HERO>fame<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>battlefield prowess<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>strategic genius<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER>creative ability<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE>sound judgement<else>good looks<end>. I know this must be a surprise to you, so I’ll give you some time to think about what I’ve said.” He gives you a fond smile and walks away.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Luxury Seekers

options.text: Very well. We will see what can be found.
[rival] has other priorities that must take precedence.
Why didn’t they just say so? The [family] are welcome to my personal supply!

events.text: You’ve noticed that certain members of the [family] family, once warm to your presence, have grown cold of late. One day after council, just as your mind is cataloging recent interactions with the [family] in search of possible causes for their discontent, you are approached by [character]. “My [title], it is somewhat of an awkward matter.” [character] presses a finger to his lips and gazes upwards, searching for the best way to proceed. “You see, the [family] have a particular fondness for [resource] and grow impatient with its absence. They claim to know the location, which I’ve taken the liberty of marking on our maps.”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Making Friends

options.text: Encourage this strong new alliance.
Accuse these conspirators of a plot.
Ingratiate ourselves to our rivals.

events.text: Our frayed relationship with [character] has finally come unwound. In a bid to circumvent our authority, he has allied with the powerful [family] family. Does this unexpected alliance have regal ambitions, or are they simply playing power games?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Malevolence

options.text: We will face these evils together.
The true battle is with enemies of [rival].

events.text: [character], a prominent leader of the [family] family, visits you privately on the throne. He wishes to inform you of the true spiritual conflict at work in [rival]... and the world. Your support is needed to combat the malevolence seeking to overthrow all mankind. Is [character] mad, or is there a wisdom in his words?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Master of Whispers

options.text: They are just friends...
It is time we got rid of our lying Spymaster.
End my husband's affair one way or another.

events.text: Word has reached our spymaster, [character], that your husband [character] is involved in amorous relations with a famous court philanderer. The pair were seen numerous times in an intimate embrace. Something must be done before rumors spread. What is your command?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Material Needs

options.text: Cease talking and accept my coin!
I cannot afford that!
Perhaps we can discuss the price…
Rough wool and leather is all I need.

events.text: A Merchant has come before you with a wondrous new type of fabric, which he calls Silk. Soft and smooth, yet strong, it is tremendously comfortable to wear in all circumstances. Best of all, it comes from a distant land and is rarely traded so far west, making it the mark of a truly great King. For an appropriate sum, the merchant will supply you with a small amount of Silk on an ongoing basis.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Military Leadership

options.text: Let us divert some of our current military resources to the task of hiring a new military leader.
We will divert civilian resources to bulk up our military leadership.
Ignore these whimperings from Court. Our current leadership is fine.

events.text: Your realm is growing and expanding, which is good, but members of your Court have been expressing concerns that you lack sufficient levels of military leadership to conduct an effective campaign, either offensively or defensively. You have the opportunity to add a new general to your ranks. All that remains is the will to do so.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Military Mind

options.text: This development is worth the effort.
We do not have the time nor resources.

events.text: A skirmisher in a rural militia has engineered a fascinating new form of military thinking. His superiors wasted no time in bringing it to our attention. The idea has great potential, but developing it will divert time and resources from other endeavors.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Military Research

options.text: Okay, I'll bite...there may be something to this.
We can't afford this, intriguing or no.

events.text: Over the course of any given day, you see dozens, if not scores of people, most of them petitioning you for favors of one sort or another. Very few of these pique your interest, but you do get the occassional surprise. This is one of those days. A commoner who has worked for weeks to gain an audience with you immediately starts talking excitedly about his ideas to modernize the nation's military. Your first impulse is to dismiss his prattle as you hear things like this all the time, but something about his passion for the subject draws you in and you feel he may be onto something. The notion of magnifying the power of the army by leveraging a range of animals in new ways seems both compelling and workable. How will you respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Must I Do Everything?

options.text: The [family] cannot be trusted with authority.
It is not my place to criticize [family] management of their affairs.

events.text: We have heard reports of chaos and inefficiency on the estates of the [family] Family. Our advisors worry that this penchant for mismanagement could extend to the rule of their Cities... and beyond. Consolidating power would take authority from the [family], but it could cause consternation among the nobles.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Mutinous Military

options.text: We must go immediately.
I will not abandon the throne.

events.text: Panic has erupted in several cities, as rumors of mutinous soldiers spread through the populace. Young recruits are turning on their officers, seizing barracks and arsenals. In the capital, military advisor [character] suggests that he spirit you away to safety, until the current chaos subsides. Chancellor [character] is skeptical, believing a flight from the palace will be seen as cowardice.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Mutiny in the Ranks

options.text: Warn him to get things into shape.
[character] is not fit to lead.
He must face the consequences of his actions.

events.text: Mutiny is afoot. A message arrives at night from a young officer in [character]’s army, warning that the troops are on the verge of rising up against him. In the midst of a recent skirmish, [character] was recklessly throwing soldiers at the enemy with little strategy, shouting that they are expendable when an unfortunate officer questioned his leadership. [character] has refused to listen to the danger from his own army and drives the soldiers harder and harder. Time is short. Will you warn [character] of the danger that he is in, despite upsetting the troops?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: My Little Ponies

options.text: A tremendous opportunity. Let us fund the entire effort, so we can simultaneously gain access to a new resource and bolster relations with the [tribe].
Let us split the cost of the effort with the [tribe].
Sadly, we lack the resources to take advantage of this opportunity.

events.text: [character] makes an unexpected appearance in your Court, brimming with excitement. "I've found a sizeable herd of wild ponies!" He exclaims. "They will be difficult to corral, but if we work together on the project, I feel certain we can manage it and it could benefit both our Peoples." It is undoubtedly a good opportunity, and you and [character] share a love of horses. How will you respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Mysterious Sickness

options.text: Send doctors to [city] right away!
Invest in research for a cure.
This disease will run its course.

events.text: Citizens of [city] suffer the ravages of a highly mysterious disease, which is said to kill 1 in 5 of the people it infects. Its origin remains unknown, but victims all share the signature pockmarks on their skin. Our scientists demand immediate action.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Mysterious Sword

options.text: Accept the sword, and give gifts to the farmer.
The sword is mine by right! Give it to me!
It is likely cursed. Send him away at once.

events.text: A poor, elderly farmer comes to court, bearing a blade of unusual metal covered in exotic designs. He discovered it in a deep network of caverns on his lands, and he believes it would make a worthy gift for a ruler. Will you take the sword?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Mystical Trance

options.text: Answers lie on a higher plane.
Sounds like superstition to me.

events.text: Several powerful members of the [family] family have started holding spiritual gatherings, where they teach visitors a powerful new form of worship. Falling into a mystical trance, they seek to expel bad emotions in an attempt to end suffering and unlock greater wisdom. Perhaps you should try it.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Naive Ambassador

options.text: Get some statesmen to teach [character] about diplomacy.
"I cannot have an idiot on the council."
Give [character] some "gifts" and send him off to [rival].

events.text: Displaying a remarkable lack of understanding, Ambassador [character] claims that our bad relationship with [rival] is absolutely groundless and could be easily fixed with a small gift. It is well known that [character] is not the wisest person on the court, but such inability to grasp diplomacy is truly striking.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: New Ambassador

options.text: It will be done.
No, [character] is too valuable.

events.text: Tensions have been high between the royal court and the [family] family. To alleviate this, the [family] request that [character] be made your Ambassador in place of [character]. What shall we say?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: New Blood

options.text: Elevating [character] is best for the nation.
We will not be coerced into ending a legacy.

events.text: In a bid for more power, the [family] wish to place one of their own, [character], on the throne. They decry the ruling bloodline as reckless and corrupt. A change in succession may have its advantages, but it will most certainly anger the heir, [character], and his bevy of devoted followers.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: New Perspectives

options.text: Divert all attention towards accurately reading the stars.
Let us see what else [character] can discover with funds behind him.
We will build [character] a place to work with other bright minds.

events.text: The Astronomer [character] has authored a treatise on astronomical and geographical calculations. In it, he puts forward that the world is a sphere rotating daily on its own axis, rather than the sky rotating around the earth. “Just as a man on a boat will see the shore as moving backwards,” he explains, “so the stationary stars appear to be moving across the sky.”

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: New Strings

options.text: I shall spend my afternoons composing new tunes for them!
I shall be rid of them... Invite them to perform a concert on the roof of the palace and let my Royal Guard use them as target practice, then hire replacements.
Ask my dear friend Governor [character] to find new musicians for me as a personal favor.

events.text: You tire of your musicians. The tunes emanating from their flutes and lyres seem unchanged since you first employed them. Perhaps a change is in order?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: Scare the birds away, so the fish may thrive.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Try to attract tourists to see the beautiful flocks.

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of fish in the coastal waters outside the city. During their migration season, these large, pink fish often become the target of passing birds. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: If we reduce the numbers of fish, more crabs will survive.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Leave this matter to the locals in [city].

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of fish in the coastal waters outside the city. These silvery blue fish appear to subsist primarily on a diet of crab. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: Sell them to the wealthy as exotic pets.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Leave this matter to the locals in [city].

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of frog in the rivers near the city. These small, colorful creatures are said to thrive in captivity. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: Declare this species a protected resource.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Leave this matter to the locals in [city].

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of lizard in the sand dunes outside the city. According to witness accounts, these reptiles show extreme resilience, and they prey on the region's other dangerous fauna. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: Sell them to the wealthy as exotic pets.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Declare this species a protected resource.

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of rodent in the frozen hills outside the city. These small, furry creatures are not populous enough to support a trade industry, but they could be useful in other ways. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: Allow interested locals to investigate.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Declare this species a protected resource.

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of snake in the fields and wetlands near the city. The snake is a strong swimmer and hides in tall reeds to conceal itself. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: New Type of Animal Discovered

options.text: Pass them off as rare collector's items.
Send an expedition to learn more about them.
Encourage citizens to report anything else of interest.

events.text: Scientists in [city] claim to have discovered a new species of spider in the streams and tributaries near the city. These fascinating creatures bury themselves deep in mud lairs, striking up at their prey from below. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Noble Excess

options.text: Require him to give us his armor, as a gift.
Melt the [family] armor down for use by the military.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Mounted
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Mounted

options.text: Commission spectacular horse armor of my own.

events.text: Members of the [family] noble family have developed an expensive obsession with horse armor, commissioning elaborate sets for their personal mounts. [character], in particular, boasts a retinue so glamorous it rivals our own. Other families are beginning to complain.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Old Enemies

options.text: Additional labor to support the military effort.
A military alliance with [rival].
Diplomatic resolutions with the [tribe].

events.text: A group of [tribe] riders thunders through the streets of the capital, headed for the court. [character] has just learned of our war with the [tribe] and wishes to supply aid. Apparently, the [tribe] and the [tribe] are ancient enemies, and [character] pledges support. The leader of the riders offers three options.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: One Who Strives

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: [character] dedication is inspiring.
We could all strive to be better.

tip: As leader: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Tribal
As general: +25% Unit Trait Modifier / Tribal

options.text: Even piety could not entice me to give up a kingdom.

events.text: [character] has been studying the life of the Buddha, from his days as the prince Siddhartha Gautama to the enlightened founder of [religion]. As prince, Siddhartha renounced his inheritance after seeing the suffering of the world. He gave up his kingdom to become a sramana: one who strives. The rest of the Buddha’s years were spent finding a path to freedom from human suffering. [character] claims his aim is to follow such a holy and pious life.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Orphans

options.text: Host a lavish festival, sparing no expense, and inviting the orphaned children of the [tribe] to attend as well.
It's a good idea, but we lack the resources to make it expansive enough to invite the [tribe].
A splendid idea, but sadly, one we simply cannot afford.

events.text: You and [character] are both like-minded leaders, and both of the opinion that the true measure of greatness of your respective realms lies not in how many troops you command, but in how the least members of your People are treated. The Harvest Festival has always been a time of celebration and thanksgiving, but not everyone gets to enjoy it. Recently, you were inspired by a conversation you had with [character] to expand the scope of the Festival to make it more accessible to everyone, including the large and growing population of orphaned children in your Realm. It would be expensive, but the benefits could be far reaching indeed, especially if you could find the resources to open the festival to the [tribe] as well. How do you wish to proceed?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Our Conservative Elders

options.text: I pay no heed to ignorant fools!
I understand their concerns, and I will concede.
I will wear a beard to resemble a man.

events.text: The [family] family expresses concerns that [rival] has a female leader. There are rumors in court of a vote to oust you from power, and to replace you with a male, the next in line, [character]. How shall you face this challenge?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Our Purpose

options.text: It is true, we must pursue a higher truth.
[rival] is on the right path.
I will personally guide our scientific development.

events.text: Walking in the gardens, [character] confides in you about his concerns with the direction of the government. "Our scientific and engineering feats are second to none, but what about the bigger question? Our purpose. To abandon this search is to abandon our very humanity." [character] is not the only one who feels this way. Many in the court, including [character], share his sentiment.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Outrage in [city]

options.text: Rein in this disorder at once!
The government will meet to review its stances.
We must let [city] burn.
I will admit my mistakes and promise change.

events.text: Outbreaks of violence have erupted in [city], where certain sects blame you for a rise in oppressive attitudes. They claim that your intolerance has sparked this burst of outrage. Local leaders appeal to the court for assistance.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Over the Hump

options.text: Use this opening to improve relations with [character].
Send out merchants of your own.
So, does this mean we can get a discount?

events.text: The Caravans of [rival] have brought an unexpected gift to [city]: [religion] has taken hold in the city, spread by the traders who made the long and arduous journey. The religion has been particularly popular with the merchants of the city, who excitedly talk about following in the steps of Trapusa and Bahalika, two merchants who gave food to the Buddha after he reached Enlightenment and became some of his early disciples.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Overabundance

options.text: The court will invest in the construction of warehouses.
This is [character]'s problem to solve.
We will create a network to distribute food elsewhere.
Raise import taxes to cut shipments but retain income.

events.text: According to [character], Governor of [city], a boom in imports has left the city struggling to house all of its vital goods. Tons of meat, fruits, vegetables, and grains are being left to rot along the harbor front. It would be a shame to let such bounty spoil, but there are only so many laborers to spare. What shall we tell Governor [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Pax Kushana

options.text: Let the people enjoy this peace while it lasts.
No, we must stay prepared for war.

events.text: Your total control of the lands has led to a time of stability and peace. People tend their lands in comfort, safe in the knowledge that they are under the protection of [rival]. It is said that a merchant can walk from one end of the nation to the other, without need for guards or fearing for their safety. Trade flourishes as your once nomadic people settle, religion and culture spreading along the merchant routes.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Personal Faith

options.text: May each of us follow our own insight.
I will not allow nobles to influence religion.

events.text: Recently, the [family] family has held a series of feasts to expound on their personal spiritual beliefs. These celebrations, steeped in [religion] ritual, set forth that the battle for salvation is a personal one, led by those with a gift for mystical insight. These ideas have started spreading beyond the [family] estates, and people are taking notice.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Personal Influence

options.text: Punish the [family] for this blatant attempt at coercion.
[character] must manage these requests himself.
I will provide him with false information to give to the [family].

events.text: Your brother [character] comes to you in secret with a personal request. Outspoken members of the [family] family have been accosting him and his wife, urging them to use their personal influence to affect your policies. He felt that he had no choice but to tell you.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Places of Worship

options.text: Let them have their cathedrals.
[religion] must find some place else to worship.

events.text: Devout members of the [family] family have spent weeks exerting pressure on our royal engineers. They desire the construction of Cathedral Christianity to house the growing number of worshippers. Do we relent to this pressure?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Places of Worship

options.text: Let them have their temples.
[religion] must find some place else to worship.

events.text: Devout members of the [family] family have spent weeks exerting pressure on our royal engineers. They desire the construction of Temple Judaism to house the growing number of worshippers. Do we relent to this pressure?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Places of Worship

options.text: Let them have their cathedrals.
[religion] must find some place else to worship.

events.text: Devout members of the [family] family have spent weeks exerting pressure on our royal engineers. They desire the construction of Cathedral Manichaeism to house the growing number of worshippers. Do we relent to this pressure?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Places of Worship

options.text: Let them have their temples.
[religion] must find some place else to worship.

events.text: Devout members of the [family] family have spent weeks exerting pressure on our royal engineers. They desire the construction of Temple Zoroastrianism to house the growing number of worshippers. Do we relent to this pressure?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Plots and Schemes

options.text: We will find a way to end these plots.
This threat calls for drastic action. [character] seeks the throne, but will only find a grave.

events.text: The royal guard brings worrisome news. [character] has been found murdered in his chambers. Our spies suspect that [character] may be responsible. It seems someone is scheming to reach the throne...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Point of No Return

options.text: I never found him particularly comely.
My heart is a cold well of grief.

events.text: The rumors are true... Your husband, [character], has departed the royal palace and fled [rival]. According to close friends and relatives, his jealousy had reached a point of no return, and he wished to pursue happiness elsewhere. Sadly, we know not where. The court grieves with you, oh [title].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Poison on the Tree

options.text: His fall must be a public example.
Let him rot in chains for the rest of his days.
Exile will teach him respect for the throne.

events.text: Servants have made an unsettling discovery in the home of your military advisor, [character]: documents detailing a plot to murder the royal family and usurp the throne. The kingdom has long admired [character] for his cunning mind, but it seems he has shed allegiance for treason. Swift action is needed.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Political Arena

options.text: Return [character] to [rival] at once, unharmed!
Oh, I am going to enjoy this...
They must spare him, but it is by my hand.

events.text: You receive an invitation to a special sporting event hosted by [character], who admires you greatly. To your astonishment, you find a makeshift arena in which a band of [tribe] warriors prepare to battle [character] in mortal combat. "You said this man was your enemy," explains [character]. "I have brought him here, so you may enjoy his demise."

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Prophet and The Parched Land

options.text: Very well, come with us.
No. We shall not bow to your demands.
Bah, this isn't a drought. We've survived worse.

events.text: There has been no rain this spring, and the streams of the land have dried up. Your horses and cattle starve for lack of grass. As the court rides throughout [rival], looking for grass for your herds, [character] appears before you in the wilderness. "Thus saith Jehovah! You have forsaken the commandments of [religion] and followed other gods. Now gather all the acolytes of the land, and rain shall return to the land."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Protect the Flanks

options.text: Create companion cavalry for protection.
Drill your soldiers until they can reform at a moment's notice.
Provide specialized sarissa training.

events.text: Despite the pivotal development of the Infantry Square, some worry that the formation presents new challenges. Soldiers wielding the long spears are extremely vulnerable to flanking attacks when moving, especially by mounted units. Our generals seek funds to explore tactics that will safeguard the rear. What shall the court command?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Protection of a Prophet

options.text: Kill [character].
Throw [character] in jail.

requirements.label: Schemer / Ruthless / Bloodthirsty
tip: The leader must have one of: Schemer; Ruthless; Bloodthirsty

options.text: Kill [character] - and the Prophet too for good measure.

events.text: [character] comes to you late one night and informs you of a plot. One of your courtiers, [character] has been making plans to kill you. [character] has prepared your guards, and is ready to seize the plotters. All he requires is your consent. Time is most short. Your guards stand ready - what shall we do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Question Authority

options.text: Soldiers are no longer his concern.
Who dares call his ruler reckless?

events.text: General [character] seeks reassurances. He fears that your recklessness with the lives of his soldiers puts them in unnecessary danger. He pleads with you to more carefully consider the consequences when deploying soldiers.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Questionable Carving

options.text: Display it in the government forum.
Erect it in the public market.
I will purchase it for myself.

events.text: A sculptor from [city] has carved a towering stone pillar in your likeness. You adore the statue, but court ministers do not share your enthusiasm. What shall be done with this work of art?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Quid Pro Quo

options.text: No. Sadly, I am unable to extend my support at this time.

events.text: [character] approaches you late one evening in the gardens. "I shall be brief for it is a small matter," he says in a somber tone. "I need you to return the favor, if possible..." How shall we respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Radical Philosopher

options.text: We will continue to use slaves.
Rid the [family] of this troublesome philosopher.

events.text: A wandering philosopher has joined the household of the [family] family. She teaches a radical idea: that no human being has the right to treat another as property. This notion has energized the [family] nobility, and they are spreading it within the court. Shall we intervene?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Regarding Your Payment

options.text: Certainly, we will pay you an additional amount and hope for continued cooperation.
While we are unable to currently pay, please accept our most humble apologies and promises to be a better neighbor.
The [tribe] had better invest what money they have left into digging graves!

events.text: Under your rule, [rival] has made extensive use of mercenaries from the region's tribes. It is certainly an effective way to boost our military through the vast [rival] wealth, but mercenaries are motivated by gold, not by loyalty or civic duty. Fortunately, you have enough gold. Unfortunately, the [tribe] decided that they do not. A [tribe] envoy has politely informed you that they are willing to accept a payment to maintain our continued coexistence, if not friendship, but are no less willing to fight us.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Reign of Terror

options.text: Let it be so. All shall fear me!
No. Morally, I cannot accept this.

events.text: Courtiers flee from you within the palace walls, whispering of your terrifying reputation. Perhaps we could use this to our advantage. The army stands with you, great [title]. Let us seize hostages from each of the families and ensure they will never rise against you, lest we kill those they love and any who stand against your rule. All hail, our tyrant [character]!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Reign of a God

options.text: I am no mere god! I am the divine emperor!
I am indeed a god among men.
No, I am merely a humble servant.

events.text: You reign, endowed by the divine, as the uncontested leader of your nation. The people bow before you as you are carried through the cities and the court. Surely, it is a mere formality to join the pantheon of the gods, for you are undoubtedly touched by the divine. Shall we name thee divine and mark this as the reign of a god?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Religious Conversion of the Danes

options.text: Help us defend our Holy Sites.
Assist the Priesthood in improving our Public Works.
You need do nothing more than leave a tithe with the High Priest.
There is nothing to be done. Welcome to our Brothers and Sisters of Faith!

events.text: A large group of [tribe] pilgrims arrives in your Court seeking an audience. Their leader bows before your throne. "We have come to pay our respects to our brothers and sisters of the faith, and offer what talents we have to your Court. We are at your service. What would you ask of the [tribe]?"

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Religious Conversion of the Gauls

options.text: Help us defend our Holy Sites.
We would appreciate the learned council of your wise men and women.
You need do nothing more than leave a tithe with the High Priest.
There is nothing to be done. Welcome to our Brothers and Sisters of Faith!

events.text: A large group of [tribe] pilgrims arrives in your Court seeking an audience. Their leader bows before your throne. "We have come to pay our respects to our brothers and sisters of the faith, and offer what talents we have to your Court. We are at your service. What would you ask of the [tribe]?"

"We have come to pay our respects to our brothers and sisters of the faith, and offer what talents we have to your Court. We are at your service. What would you ask of the [tribe]?"

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Religious Conversion of the Scythians

options.text: Help us defend our Holy Sites.
Bolster our efforts to train our armies in defense of Holy Lands.
You need do nothing more than leave a tithe with the High Priest.
There is nothing to be done. Welcome to our Brothers and Sisters of Faith!

events.text: A large group of [tribe] pilgrims arrives in your Court seeking an audience. Their leader bows before your throne. "We have come to pay our respects to our brothers and sisters of the faith, and offer what talents we have to your Court. We are at your service. What would you ask of the [tribe]?"

We would appreciate the learned council of your wise men and women.
You need do nothing more than leave a tithe with the High Priest.
There is nothing to be done. Welcome to our Brothers and Sisters of Faith!

"We have come to pay our respects to our brothers and sisters of the faith, and offer what talents we have to your Court. We are at your service. What would you ask of the [tribe]?"

options.text: Help us defend our Holy Sites.
Bolster our efforts to train our armies in defense of Holy Lands.
You need do nothing more than leave a tithe with the High Priest.
There is nothing to be done. Welcome to our Brothers and Sisters of Faith!
