"We have come to pay our respects to our brothers and sisters of the faith, and offer what talents we have to your Court. We are at your service. What would you ask of the [tribe]?"

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Religious Debate

options.text: Agree with [religion].
[religion] has a better argument.
Your piety impresses them both.

events.text: The [religion] and the [religion] are locked in a doctrinal debate about the significance of sacred objects to the divine. The <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>Magi argue that objects themselves cannot be sacred, only representations of the divine spirits and virtues<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>Presbyters believe that the relics left by Jesus and the Saints give a tangible connection to them<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>Kohanim put forwards that when copying out their texts, the very act is sacred and that lends the sacred aura to the scrolls<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>Elect posit that material objects belong to the world of darkness and only the spiritual world is holy<p=SUBJECT_BUDDHISM>Bhikkhu believe that the relics and other spiritual objects can be tools of teaching and reflection<p=SUBJECT_HINDUISM>Brahmins say that devotional icons can be a divine manifestation<else>Priests suggest that a statue of the divine is holy, but only after it has been completed by the craftsman and consecrated with special rites<end>, while the <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>Magi argue that objects themselves cannot be sacred, only representations of the divine spirits and virtues<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>Presbyters believe that the relics left by Jesus and the Saints give a tangible connection to them<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>Kohanim put forwards that when copying out their texts, the very act is sacred and that lends the sacred aura to the scrolls<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>Elect posit that material objects belong to the world of darkness and only the spiritual world is holy<p=SUBJECT_BUDDHISM>Bhikkhu believe that the relics and other spiritual objects can be tools of teaching and reflection<p=SUBJECT_HINDUISM>Brahmins say that devotional icons can be a divine manifestation<else>Priests suggest that a statue of the divine is holy, but only after it has been completed by the craftsman and consecrated with special rites<end>. Who do you favor?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Renouncing the Crown

options.text: It is time for the next generation to steward [rival].
I may not want the trappings of royal life, but I will stay to give [character] guidance.
Like it or not, the crown is mine to bear.

events.text: Your mind has been troubled of late. The weight of the crown bears heavy, and [character] is as ready as he will ever be to take the throne. Your scant moments of solace come from retreating to your [religion] observances. In one such moment of reflection, you find yourself caught in a tide of questions: Is the remainder of your life to be spent under the yoke of the crown? Is it too late to walk a different path? Could such a change bring you closer to the teachings of?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Restless Leader

options.text: Assemble the royal caravan. We ride at dawn!
The wise man stays at home.

events.text: Recently, you have a felt a certain restlessness. You simply aren't content to wait about at home, bored by the mundanity of palace duties and court ceremony. Being<p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN> a Tactician Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world, and learn from the great strategists of foreign lands.<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE> a Judge Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world, and study the legal systems of foreign lands.<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR> an Orator Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world, and learn from the great speakers and diplomats of foreign lands.<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR> a Scholar Archetype, you are eager to travel far and wide to study the great books and libraries of the world.<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER> a Builder Archetype, you are eager to travel far and wide to study the building methods of the world's great architects.<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER> a Schemer Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world with a keen eye for studying new methods in subterfuge and skulduggery.<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER> a Commander Archetype, you are eager to visit foreign military officers and academies, and study their leadership styles.<p=SUBJECT_ZEALOT> a Zealot Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world to meet the pious wherever they might be.<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT> a Diplomat Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world and sharpen your diplomatic skills at foreign courts.<p=SUBJECT_HERO> a Hero Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world in search of adventure and danger.<else> a Tactician Archetype, you are eager to travel out into the world, and learn from the great strategists of foreign lands.<end> Shall you set out into the world at large on a grand adventure?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Rift in the Court

options.text: We shall imprison [character], to be safe.
Punish [character] for disrupting the court.
Let them overcome their own grievances.

events.text: [character] has accused fellow courtier [character] of corruption and treason. However, we know both of these people well and suspect that this accusation is born of jealousy more than of loyalty. One of our ministers is lying...

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Riots at the Races

options.text: Execute the ringleaders as an example!
Spare the men so as not to anger the masses.
Send in the army! Crush the rioters!
Despite the scale of the violence, this is a matter for the local courts.

events.text: A riot broke out today at the circus of [city] during the chariot races between the supporters of the Blue, Green, Red, and White teams. The ringleaders have been rounded up. What should we do with them?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ritual Steps

options.text: Give them the funds that they ask for.
[religion] should be systematically supported by the crown.
The Brahmins are out of touch, the times are changing.

events.text: As [city] grows, the [religion] Brahmins have been struggling to keep hold of their role as spiritual guides of the city’s populace. With urban expansion, the old Vedic fire sacrifices have been growing increasingly complex and, by extension, expensive. With their patronage under threat, the rural Brahmins are now asking to be sponsored by the court.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ritual and Life

options.text: Start writing them up.
Refuse to follow such laws.

events.text: Since the adoption of [religion] by [rival], the religion has become increasingly tied with the [rival] national identity. The laws of purity that dictate what a person may and may not do have been adopted by the majority of [rival] as a matter of day to day life. Your advisors have suggested that it may be worth formalizing the [religion] purity laws into a Legal Code that would make them enforceable. However, even you would be bound by the new laws.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Ritual of the Pit

fields: aeRandomTraitDelay: TRAIT_WOUNDED, TRAIT_POISONED, TRAIT_TOUGH, TRAIT_FIERCE, TRAIT_SWIFT

options.text: A worthy challenge indeed! When do we start?
I will not risk life and limb, but wish to support these kinds of traditions.
Uhh...yeah no. That's nuts.

events.text: A new opportunity to improve relations with the [tribe] has presented itself, provided that you're willing to accept some personal risk. [character] has invited you to participate in one of their sacred rituals. If you accept, the two of you will be lowered into an expansive pit, shackled together, one of you armed with a spear, and the other with an axe and shield. Running along the edges of the pit are a variety of urns and cages. These contain all manner of beasts; venomous snakes, feral pigs, hunger-crazed wolves, forest cats and the like. At unpredictable intervals, the spectators above will open the cages or break the urns, releasing their occupants. You and [character] must battle these foes together. If you both still live when the sun rises, you will be considered an honorary member of the [tribe], and will be blood bonded with the tribal leader.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Room For One More?

options.text: As long as [character] supports the idea, then yes!
No. I do not feel comfortable with this. It seems most... unwise.

events.text: Your husband is both loving and politically astute. When an offer of marriage arrives from [tribe], he immediately responds favorably to the idea, assuaging any misgivings you may have had about the arrangement. It is an important opportunity that may well ensure your long-term success. What say you?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Rule by God's Will

options.text: It has a certain ring to it.
No, I cannot accept these titles. I am a servant, nothing more.
Rally the faithful! We must defend our lands!

events.text: Monasteries and temples cover the land, built in mighty cities to spread the creed of [religion]. The faithful rejoice across the land for surely you are doing the work of God, and they have taken to calling you the Defender of the Faith! How might we benefit from this?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Rule with an Iron Fist

options.text: We must re-enforce the support of the army.
Prepare to subdue the families.
Rally our Culture! We must not falter!

events.text: The power of the royals has never been greater in your nation's history. Citizens and nobles whisper and gossip about the daily activities of your family with a tinge of wonder and awe. The people adore you, and the families fear you. How shall we further burnish our reputation and cower our enemies?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Runaway Slave

options.text: Reprimand the ruling family in [city].
We should not meddle in such affairs.
Have him beaten and returned to [city].

events.text: A runaway slave from [city] has reached the court. Before he is led away in chains, the slave describes the unbearable conditions in which he and his people are expected to live. His words paint a terrible scene. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Sabotage

options.text: I will make them pay for their insolence.
It is time to mend ties with the [family].

events.text: Unhappy with our rule, [family] saboteurs have destroyed several improvements in the capital! They seek to deface and topple those landmarks that define us as a nation. This cannot stand!

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Scholars In Arms

options.text: A splendid idea! Tell me what you need.
Sadly, this is not something we can afford to do.

events.text: You and [character] have a lot in common. A shared bond arising from a love of knowledge. It is in this spirit that the Chieftain of the [tribe] approaches you with a proposition. His tribe is home to a fair number of learned men and women, but the unfortunate truth is that they lack the resources to conduct proper research. You can help with that. If you would be willing to fund their research efforts, the [tribe] will happily share the fruits of their research with you. What say you?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Second Class Citizens

options.text: The original [rival] citizens are to be treated with respect.
The [rival] citizens of [city] will learn to accept their place.

events.text: The original [rival] inhabitants of [city] have become de facto second class citizens since our rule began. Our own [rival] colonists have adopted a superior attitude towards them, mostly due to the influence of the ruling [family], who have become infamous in [city] for their haughty attitude. The [rival] are seething with resentment at this treatment, and both the [rival] nation and our own [family] Family will be watching our next move carefully.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Secret Fund

options.text: We will correct this error in judgement and move on.
Everyone seems happy with the current arrangement.
Not only do I want justice, but I am owed back payments.

events.text: Court merchants bring to your attention a significant discrepancy in the taxes paid by the [family] family. It appears that the [family] has been diverting gold meant for the royal vaults into their own coffers and estates. This sensitive information has yet to be revealed to the court, so there is time for you to choose the best course of action.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Secret Rituals

options.text: A governor rules his city as he chooses.
All locals and city leaders must be reminded of my authority.
Remove [character] from power at once.
We must prune this family line before it grows.
I am fascinated by these secret festivals. Tell me more.

events.text: [character] grows displeased with reports from [city], where Governor [character] is said to defy the court's rule. Agents claim that he holds secret rituals in honor of an obscure god, no doubt the influence of his peculiar husband [character]. Troubling accounts are nothing new, but [character] and [character] have taken them to a new height with their profane displays.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Sewer System

options.text: Provide [city] with the requested experts.
Fund the development of a sewage system.
Lend the court's full support to this effort.

events.text: Members of the [city] leadership request the assistance of our royal engineers. They wish to experiment with a sanitary system of disposing of sewage, and vaulted ceilings are central to their designs. The idea has merit. Perhaps we should explore it further.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Shakha Schools

options.text: Some may object, but I will enforce a single [religion] Orthodoxy.
We will reach out to the religious leaders to try to find unity.
It is not my place to govern their beliefs.

events.text: The people of [city] are at odds over their [religion] faith, with various factions supporting different reading of the Vedas. The school of thought that each follows is not purely theological or hypothetical. It extends into every aspect of the way they seek to live their life. These divides between the different readings are becoming increasingly entrenched across [rival], even extending to the court.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Shaping The Future

options.text: Provide [character] with the funds necessary to acquire this new drink.
Rather than providing luxuries, we should focus on bringing mercantile expertise to Court.
Why not do both?
At present, we cannot afford any of these options.

events.text: Though young, [character] is already quite active in affairs of the Court. He has big ideas, and is anxious to begin implementing them in order to shape the Realm he will one day inherit. You don't mind a certain amount of this, and have been letting your heir take the reins from time to time in order to give him some practical experience. Now is one of those times. [character] has made what he feels is an important connection, and it is within your power to give him the resources to take advantage of it. Apparently, [character] is a well-traveled merchant who claims he can provide your Kingdom with a delightful rare drink that may please your nobles. On the other hand, simply bringing this talented tradesman to the Court to lend [character] his expertise could be invaluable. It's time to make a decision.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Sign from Aten

options.text: Aten is the god of Egypt, whether everyone likes it or not.
This is not a sign unless we accept it. Send the gifts back.

events.text: You pray daily to the many gods of Egypt, as did your ancestors, as did their ancestors. But something has changed. Of the pantheon, your interest has been drawn to the Sun god Aten, the rays of his power reaching out and giving life to all below. This morning you awake with new knowledge. Aten spoke to you in your dream and now you plainly see that he is the leader of the gods, standing above all others. As Aten's heavenly disk shone brightly, he told you that there will be a sign to confirm that the dream was true. In the afternoon three envoys show up at the palace, each from a different master and each bearing gifts. This has to be a sign from Aten. Still, many would find the very idea too radical.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Sinister Devotion

options.text: We will find a way to end these plots.
This threat calls for drastic action. [character] cannot scheme from beyond the grave.

events.text: Another death rocks the court. Another... murder. Our spies suggest that [character] was behind the shocking killing of [character], part of an orchestrated attempt to move his husband, [character], closer to the throne.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Sink of the World's Gold

options.text: Let them have the gold. The benefits are well worth the cost.
We must not allow this unfettered trade to continue.
Charge [character] with keeping a keen eye on the nation's exports.

events.text: Trade with [rival] has been going well. So well, in fact, that your administrators are concerned about how much of your nation’s gold is being carted away into the hands of the foreign land. A lesser known member of your court, [character], suggests a solution: It's possible to put a ban in place to keep gold in [rival], although such a drastic action will not be popular with the families profiting from the open trade.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Small-Mindedness

options.text: Our policies are too severe.
A few isolated incidents mean nothing.
We must root out corruption.

events.text: Reports of widespread abuses on the [family] estates have reached the capital, indicative of a growing problem. Our strict laws of conformity have led to incidents across [rival]. Violence against immigrants. Religious intolerance. Even the court suffers from such small-mindedness. [character] of the [family] denies the accusations of severe treatment, warning that changing the laws would unleash chaos.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Soldier of Fortune

options.text: We could always use another talented soldier.
No. Not at this time.

events.text: [character] has been sighted repeatedly in your Realm. He has a reputation as a fierce and reliable warrior who sells his martial talents to the highest bidder. It occurs to you that it might be in your best interest to give him a job at Court than let him roam free until someone else hires him for that could work against our interests.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Sometimes the Gods Smile

rewards.text: Begin project: Shrine of the Unknown God

options.text: We should take no chances where the gods are concerned. Let's build the shrine in hopes of appeasing any we may not be aware of.
While we may be a bit superstitious, there's no need to get carried away...

events.text: You and [character] have been spending increasing amounts of time together. Since you have, one thing has become strikingly clear. The world works in mysterious ways. Some of the wise men and women in your Court insist that there are perfectly reasonably explanations for all the things you and your People do not understand, but you doubt that. So much that happens in the world seems to happen according to the whims of the gods and...what if you're not appeasing the right ones? It is a topic you and [character] have discussed more than once. Inspired by the most recent of those conversations, you think you've hit upon a way to cover all your bases and hopefully keep your Realm safe from the darker whims of the gods. What if you simply built a shrine to an Unknown God? That way, if some rogue god you're not appeasing sees it, maybe they'll pass your Kingdom by, sparing it from whatever ravages they may have otherwise thought to inflict. It seems like a worthwhile project to you and [character] heartily agrees. What say you?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Sorry State of Furnishings

options.text: An easy problem to solve. I shall send my spouse over to advise and provide funds to update the furnishings of the governor’s palace and the city’s décor.
Ridicule [character] mercilessly for his poor standards.
[character] is a dear friend. I shall go personally and help him improve things.
Say nothing. It's not worth causing a fuss over.

events.text: You are aghast! You have just attended, as guest of honor, a feast arranged by [character], governor of [city]. The feast itself was fine, but you couldn’t help but note the sorry state of the furniture in the governor’s palace, and the shabby condition of the decorations displayed throughout the city.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Source of Power

options.text: I agree with [character]'s support of centralization.
[character] is right about dividing power.
Let them work it out themselves.

events.text: Proposed policies divide the court. [character] and [character] disagree passionately on the direction of the government. [character] urges us to centralize authority here in the capital, while [character] wishes to cede more power to the vassal families and their cities. We cannot afford to have two such influential individuals at odds. How shall we fix this?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Southern Expedition

options.text: Expansion is a worthy Ambition.
We must strengthen our nation.
Let us discuss a resolution over revels.

events.text: The [family]' increasing interest in exotic luxuries threatens to drive a wedge between vassal families. Now rumors swirl about a desire for a military build-up for a possible expedition to the south. Members of the [family] family attack the [family] for wanting to waste vital resources on a ridiculous mission. According to the [family], the focus of the [rival] court should be on [rival].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Spare Time

options.text: Establish a school of scholarly study.
Invest in training for skilled laborers.
Drill our most elite military units.

events.text: Despite your many responsibilities, you find yourself with several hours of extra time at the end of each day. Consider it a blessing. How will you spend this time?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Special Recognition

options.text: We have no choice but to yield to him.
Let him make demands until he is blue in the face.
Only one title is good enough for him: horse's ass.

events.text: After numerous bitter encounters, [character] comes to us, demanding a unique position on the court, one with true power and responsibility. [character] has proven to be a thorn in our side, but if ignored, he also has the power to make our lives more difficult.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Speech in Your Honor

options.text: [character]
[character]
[character]

events.text: Your courtiers have arranged a mighty feast to celebrate your magnificent twenty years of rule. The highlight, so they inform you, is having a famed writer give a recital. Who do you appoint to give the main entertainment of the evening?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Sticky Fingers

options.text: Execute [character] for cheating the throne.
Keep his skills on the court.
Turn a blind eye as he flees the empire.

events.text: Two scribes come to us in secret, fearing for their lives. They suspect that the great merchant [character] has been altering records to benefit his family, the [family]. They produce evidence, but while it exposes [character]'s treachery, it also proves his masterful skills as a merchant. This is not an easy decision.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Strange Denouncement

options.text: Despite the odd reason, this is a serious threat!

events.text: A merchant who trades with [tribe] brings troubling news. [character] has announced his condemnation of us, because.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Subversive

options.text: Expose the plot before [character] can act.
Have our Spymaster plan an "accident" for [character].
Order a review of records to prove our innocence.

events.text: One of our most devoted courtiers, [character], has been absent from his duties for weeks. Now we know why. Using his vast array of political connections, [character] has been fabricating spurious claims about other members of court, and even the royal personage! Bribery. Corruption. Treason. The rumor is that he plans to bring these charges against you in public soon...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Succession Change

options.text: Very well. Make the change.
Succession is not up for debate.

events.text: An agent of the [family] family pulls us aside, demanding changes to the laws of succession. The [family] desire one of their own as heir, preferably [character]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Sudden Insight

options.text: Write it down and unveil it in the morning.
Sell the idea to a wise merchant.

events.text: Nights can be long when you bear the mantle of leadership. However, one evening, as you lie in bed half asleep, you experience a flash of insight. Something bold. Something that will improve the lives of your subjects. What do you do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Supply Chain Woes

options.text: We must cease overextending ourselves.
The [family] must work harder to control [city].
I will make an appeal to the workers.

events.text: Riots erupt along the coast of [city], as dock workers protest the hardship of supporting the government's colonial aims. [character], a patron of the ruling [family] family, arrives to air local grievances. Our efforts to dominate foreign lands have pushed our supply chain to the limit.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Surrender Authority

options.text: We should trust them to rule their own lands.
Refuse this blatant attempt to seize power.
More bureaucrats will stamp out corruption.

events.text: Nobles from the [family] and [family] families come to court to challenge our centralized government. They present compelling evidence of corruption, inefficiency, and power mongering. They believe the solution lies in surrendering authority to the various noble families. The government may be broken, but is giving the [family] and [family] more power the solution?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Survivors

options.text: Promote military leadership in [city].
Recognize the heroic [unit].
Declare this a national holiday.

events.text: Our recently forged Barding has proven its worth! In the recent battle, our [unit] unit survived a potential onslaught to sweep the enemy and win the day. Their officers are calling for a celebration in the capital as a display of appreciation.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Swords or Plowshares

options.text: Ready our forces. I choose the path of war.
Let us remain vigilant, but focus our attention on peace and prosperity.

events.text: A soothsayer recently told you that your Realm stood at a crossroads. "Down one path, I see peace and prosperity. Down the other, war and the potential for conquest. Whichever you choose, one will appear to help guide you." You sense the truth of her words, and find yourself torn between competing needs and priorities. In this moment, which path will you choose?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Symbolic Gesture

options.text: I will not participate in this ritual.
It is a symbolic gesture and means nothing.
I must cease my doubting and commit.
The fate of [rival] is in my hands alone.

events.text: You have been asked by the [family] to visit a local temple to attend a blessing of the coming year. The elder patrons have long admired your spiritual devotion, and they believe your rule is watched over by the divine. As a symbolic gesture, the [family] would like you to proclaim the righteousness of [religion] and denounce [religion] and all other religions.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Talent Scout

options.text: Let us add a merchant to the Court.
We could always use more military leaders.
Sadly, at present we lack the resources to add anyone.

events.text: Members of your inner circle are constantly on the lookout for new worthies to add to your court. Recently, a pair of new talents have been brought to your attention, a stalwart soldier and a gifted trader. Given the difficulties of bringing them to Court from afar, it would be impractical to bring both before you, but one or the other could be arranged easily enough. Which are you more interested in?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tempting Rumors

options.text: Yes, tell us everything.
No, we trust him.

events.text: A rival of [character] has offered us damning information about him. If the information goes public, it will undoubtedly damage his standing with the people. What shall we do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Tentacles of Corruption

options.text: We will initiate new policies of corruption reform.
I have no problems with [character] exerting his influence.
Interesting... How can I join his scheme for power?

events.text: The court's productivity has come to a standstill. Reported corruption in the house of [character] has spread its dark tentacles throughout the ruling class, infecting every aspect of our government. It is the court's opinion that we root out this depraved rot before it sets in permanently.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Bad Seed

options.text: Murderers belong behind prison walls.
Military service is the best place for killers.
He must die... but make it look like an accident.
This can be solved with the proper treatment.

requirements.label: Cruel / Bloodthirsty
tip: The leader must have one of: Cruel; Bloodthirsty

options.text: It IS amusing. Well done, son!

events.text: You are roused in the dead of night by the palace guards. A dead body, killed by, has been discovered in your son [character] chambers. Despite the gristly scene, [character] shows no remorse. In fact, he seems to find the murder amusing. You have ignored the warning signs, but now something must be done.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Big Picture

options.text: [rival] cannot remain insular forever.
We are the only nation that matters.
I will convince [character] to see my worldview.

events.text: "The world is changing," says [character]. "Our family wishes to change with it." The [family] have petitioned the court to rethink its current laws, urging us to engage in a more inquisitive approach to exploration and expansion. Perhaps it is time to look beyond [rival] at the bigger picture.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Dance of Vengeance

options.text: By all means! Guards, see to the heir's desire.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: We shall not kill for sport, but [character] shall be exiled.
Enough! I will not be manipulated into killing a courtmember.

events.text: Your son [character] comes to you, and tells of his latest undertaking before the court. Overjoyed, you promise that he shall receive one wish. Bowing low, he says, "Give me the head of [character] on a platter." Without a doubt, you know that [character] is behind this scheme.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Dancing Ass

options.text: I never liked his dancing.

events.text: One evening as you dine, the heir's ridiculous fool, Lord Horse's Ass, dances for the king's table. It is a minor diversion. As you prepare for bed that night, a terrible pain encircles your heart. Squeezing. Stabbing. Agony. Lord Horse's Ass must have slipped something into your drink, at the behest of [character]. You have been betrayed.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Enemy of My Enemy

options.text: Let's hit [rival] with everything we have. Declare war on [rival] and fund the training of new units for the [tribe].
We should aid [character] quietly, so as not to be drawn into the war ourselves. Fund the training of new units for the [tribe], but do it quietly.
Although all the warring is distasteful, this is none of our concern.

events.text: Tensions have been running high in your Realm of late, with battles swirling around the whole of the region. Thus, it is perhaps no great surprise when [character] rides to your Court, seeking an audience. "As you are no doubt aware," he begins, "We are currently giving battle to [rival]. Our war does not go well, but you could help change that." The full meaning of his words hang heavy on the air. How do you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Eruption

options.text: Donate to aid victims of the volcano.
Organize a relief effort.
Focus on studying the mountain.

events.text: The unthinkable has happened. For days slight tremors shook [city], and nothing was thought of it. But now the mountain is crowned with ash and fire, spewing poisonous fumes that block out the light of the sun and roll down towards the city in waves. The destruction has devastated [city]. Something must be done quickly in the face of this tragedy, what will your response be?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Finer Things

options.text: Elephants from the savannah.
Knowledge of a strange new science.
Treasures from a legendary hoard.

events.text: Your epicurean reputation precedes you. It is no surprise then that an exotic goods merchant appears in court, wishing to present you with a gift from his faraway land. What strikes your fancy?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Flood

fields: aeBonuses: BONUS_ORDERS_LOSS_AVERAGE, BONUS_FOOD_GAIN_MINIMAL, BONUS_STONE_GAIN_MINIMAL, BONUS_WOOD_GAIN_MINIMAL, BONUS_IRON_GAIN_MINIMAL

options.text: Send teams to salvage from the destruction.
We will pray that it doesn’t happen again.

events.text: The waters of the river that runs through [city] are normally swift but manageable. Not today. A sudden downpour of rain has seen the banks break, with water flooding into the city and destroying buildings. The people of [city] have rallied together and are prepared to make the most of this tragedy.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Harvest Festival

options.text: Attend and stick close to [character], focusing on improving relations.
Attend to show off my prowess in battle.
Attend and focus on securing a supply of essentials for the Realm.
Sadly, we will be unable to attend this year.

events.text: You have been invited to attend the annual harvest festival hosted by the [tribe]. The week long event is always memorable, brimming with feasting and fighting. It also presents opportunities for diplomacy. If you wish to attend, what is your primary aim this year?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Illusion of Life

options.text: This crown is a hindrance.
I can still give to those in need.
Maybe in another life.

events.text: Life, death, rebirth. These form the great cycle that every soul is tied to throughout the ages: Samsara. Escaping this cycle and obtaining the peace of Nirvana is the ultimate goal of those who follow the path of the Buddha. Yet surrounded by the trappings of your royalty, how is one to achieve enlightenment? If the material world is an illusion, then what does it mean to be [title]?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Labyrinth

options.text: Yes, build the Labyrinth.
Not only should we build it, but I will be the first to enter!
It would be a waste of energy.

events.text: The Sages of [city] are asking to build a massive Labyrinth to challenge and entertain the people. [character] makes a personal request to satisfy his family.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Last Command

options.text: Defend your right to Rome until the last breath.
Escape for a life in exile.

events.text: [character] has not rested in his efforts to gain support amongst the aristocracy of [rival]. Finally showing his hand, the ambitious schemer makes a bid for leadership, doing the unthinkable and marching his gathered forces on [city] herself. As no one would ever think that a fellow [rival] would march on the city, the attack takes you unaware, and you are left scrambling to gather a defense out of gladiators and whomever else will fight. [character] bats the forces aside, and you are left with a simple choice. Death or exile?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Literate

options.text: Hard labor will ease his troubled mind.
Adopt his "alphabet," and employ him in court.
Use this system to spread news of our civilization!

events.text: Our scouts cross paths with an eccentric traveler who claims to have established a new system of communication. He says it is a "written language," known as an "alphabet," and that it uses symbols and inscriptions to record knowledge for posterity.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Mechanism

options.text: Destroy this cursed mechanism.
How can we take advantage of this discovery?
Teach us how it works.

events.text: In court, the great thinker [character] places a strange bronze object before the throne. Composed of numerous moving pieces and rotating gears, the object proves both intriguing... and unsettling. [character] explains that his "mechanism" predicts the changing night sky, but others in court joke that it predicts his madness.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Middle Path

options.text: Maybe I too can change.
I can only aspire to such control.
About time. Let's celebrate!

events.text: [character] days as an ascetic have been tiring, the fasting and life of self-rigor collecting a toll on the body and the soul. He has found a different path. [character] has become enamored with the teachings of the Buddha, who also went through a stage of extreme asceticism. Following the Buddha, [character] now seeks a middle way, finding a route of moderation between asceticism and excess through discipline of both the mind and body. Someday, he tells you, this could even lead to enlightenment.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Monkey's Paw

options.text: Throw the disgusting thing into the fire!
[character] should ignore childish stories.
Perhaps I should take it... just in case.

events.text: During a feast following a young noble's wedding, [character] reveals a shriveled monkey's paw to those in attendance. The grotesque trophy was given to him while traveling in exotic lands far beyond the borders of [rival]. According to [character], the paw was cursed by a bitter old conjurer. It will grant its owner a wish... but at a terrible cost.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Other Religion

options.text: Make [religion] the new State Religion.
Refuse and stay true to the ways of [religion].

events.text: Your subject [character] comes before you. “You may not be aware, my [title], but I act as the leader of [religion] across the lands. Although we currently support [religion], would it not be better to support a religion that supports you? Make [religion] the State Religion of [rival] and we will be unstoppable.” Will you take up his offer?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Perfume Merchant

options.text: Perfume, you say? Let's definitely get some and try it!
We should not only acquire this 'Perfume,' but also add [character] to our Court.
Alas, we must focus on fundamentals just now. Fineries will have to wait.

events.text: Your heir [character] is a credit to the Realm and is taking every opportunity to make contacts and extend your influence, and by extension his own. That includes a recent friendship with [character], a merchant of some renown. Recently, [character] brought back some exotic perfume from his travels, but it's not overly popular with the [tribe]. Given that, you have an opportunity to acquire the supply if you like.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Pitfalls of Restraint

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: A sufficiently disciplined and wealthy court is a necessity, not bigger muscles.
You make a well reasoned argument. We shall allow unarmed duels.
We cannot build an empire while fighting amongst ourselves.

events.text: As you walk the halls of the palace, hearing the calming patter of earnest ministers and efficient coin-counters, a young warrior stops before you, begging for you to consider the lack of martial prowess in your court. "We strain ourselves for naught but coin, a bitter and harsh mistress, growing weak in the process."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Pointy End

options.text: Research improvements to armor.
Develop better battlefield healing.
We will ensure that our archers are superior.

events.text: The bodkin arrow has proven to be an eye-opening development. Not only does it highlight the subtleties of arrowhead design, but it also reveals the deficiencies of current armor. Some in court request that we explore improvements in protection for our soldiers. Imagine if someone turned these deadly weapons against us?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Polemicist

options.text: [character] must be punished for his lies!
We are above such petty rhetoric.
Rebut [character] publicly so all may see his foolishness.

events.text: [character] has been giving lengthy public speeches in [city] condemning our rule. Public opinion in [city] is beginning to turn against us.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Prodigal Father

options.text: Pay it. There is always more money.
Borrow the money from our family allies.
Divert funds from another source.

events.text: You have thrown one lavish party too many. The decorations, servants, food, and entertainment are so expensive that you are forced to either raid the royal coffers or borrow Money from the [family] Family to satisfy your creditors. However, the latter option may put you in a compromising position.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Prophet From The Sea

options.text: Join us. Together we shall cry mightily to God, and turn from our sins.
Throw this madman out.
Place a bounty on the head of this sea monster!

events.text: Several days ago a ragged man, [character], stinking of fish and salt, appeared in streets of [city]. He claims he spent three days and nights in the belly of a sea monster, and bears a message from God. "Repent! Yet forty days, and [city] shall be overthrown!"

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Prophet's Rebuke

options.text: I am the [title], I may do as I please.
We have sinned. May god forgive us as we repent.

events.text: [character] stalks into the court, disturbed courtiers skitter away from him as he marches to the throne with a feral look in his eyes. "Hear the words of God! You have abandoned his commands and turned your back on his ways. Blessings he promised if only you would keep his commands, but you have sinned greatly!" He turns to the gathered court, his face most grave. "<p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_CARNAL>You indulge in every carnal desire of life and revel in it, even as the poor die in the streets!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_WEAK>You act as a blathering imbecile, and no one in the court stands against your weak rule!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_VILLAINOUS>Your rapacious nature terrifies the citizens of the land, and cows this stable of donkeys!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_VAIN>Your flagrant expenditures and luxuries burden the people, even as the land rots beneath you!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_COVERT>Your ceaseless schemes and plots rises near to the epitome of evil, and for what? Power? Fame? Glory? You are a fool to chase these!<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_TERRIFYING>You are a bull who seeks to cow those weaker then you. You stamp about bellowing mightily and trampling those weaker than you, but you care not for the lost soul.<p=SUBJECT_CHARACTER_SEVEN_SINS>You prance about the court as if you were unchallenged, thinking yourself better then us, and ordering untold thousands to their deaths.<else>You grieve the heart of god with your many sins and the people suffer for it.<end> Please my [title], I beg of you. Return to God and forsake your sinful ways."

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Public Relations Guild

options.text: Of course! One must endeavor to use every tool available, after all.
I don't mind sharing, but, in this case, I think not.

events.text: You're developing quite the reputation at Court. Your parties are both frequent and legendary, and the people who attend can find and partake in just about any delight they can imagine. In fact, you've even developed a close circle of friends who have playfully dubbed themselves 'The Public Relations Guild,' who exist to perform services for you by servicing anyone whose opinion you need to influence. Although The Public Relations Guild has so far limited their duties to your extended Court, it occurs to you that the [tribe] warriors who live in the area could almost certainly be swayed by the Guild's 'talents.' Should you arrange a private party for some of the tribal leaders?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Right Way

options.text: Following the teachings is enough.
Sacrifice is an essential part of [religion].

events.text: A debate is raging between [character] and [character]. [character] asks, what is the point of burnt offerings if you do not do what the Lord requires? It is enough to act with justice and kindness, and to remain humble before God. [character] insists that sacrifice is a vital part of the [religion] worship to please God. Is it enough to follow the ways of God or is temple sacrifice required as well?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Righteous Path

options.text: [religion] cannot gather in large numbers.
The faithful may move and congregate as they please.
I will not get involved.

events.text: [religion] travelers from across the nation have descended on [city] to worship at their many shrines and holy sites. While most citizens do not seem to mind the increased activity, others express concern over the number of zealots in their streets. It puts them ill at ease. Your reputation as a righteous ruler demands a response.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The School of Hard Knocks

options.text: No need to intervene. Let [character] take his lumps as they come.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Hire [character] and quietly add him to Court. Direct him to focus [character]'s education on discipline.
Reach out to the high chief of the [tribe] and ensure that [character] is too busy to spend time with your heir.

events.text: When your heir, [character], was younger, he was picked on mercilessly by [character]. As they have gotten older, the two have become friends, but there is still a strong sense of competitiveness between them that sometimes turns violent. You have watched this from afar and said nothing. It occurs to you, however, that if you selectively intervene, you could guide [character]'s development. Will you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Shipwrecked Sailor

options.text: Agree to support [character] endeavor.
Encourage [character] to satisfy his curiosity of the world elsewhere.
Focus [character] towards salvaging the wreckage of the ship.

events.text: After a fierce storm railed against the coast of [city] for a week, the weather has finally receded to reveal the wreck of an unknown origin. A single survivor made it to shore and has been nursed back to health by the locals. Investigating the strange story, [character] has become enamored with the sailor’s tales of his distant homeland. [character] is now determined to mount an expedition to sail to this land in hopes of opening up new trade routes for [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Spice of Life

options.text: Subsidize the cost of imported pepper.
It is not my problem that [character] cannot manage his finances.
Why pay for imports when we could grow our own?

events.text: As trade prospers, black pepper has grown to such popularity that it is used in even the most simple of meals. However, importing such spices does not come cheap. “The taste is all well and good,” [character] grumbles, “But the amount my cook uses on my meals is going to lead me to bankruptcy!”

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Sword Saint

options.text: Yes! Let us add this talented man to our Court!
I think [character] would be of more use as a crowd pleaser. Let us build an arena and let him perform.
Sadly, we cannot afford to take advantage of this opportunity at present.

events.text: [character] is the greatest swordsman you have ever seen. He is also a longtime friend of your heir, [character]. [character] has been pressing you to bring [character] into the fold, adding him as a Courtier and potential general for your armies, but it occurs to you that there might be an even better use for him. As ever, the final decision is yours.,..

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Thunder and the Silence

options.text: This is something we simply must do, costs be damned.
Much as it pains me to admit it, we cannot afford the expense right now.

events.text: Few things are more satisfying than the thunder of hooves as your cavalry units bear down on your enemies, bringing swift and certain death. Of course, the opposite is also true. Few things are more terrifying than the sound of thunder just before an enemy cavalry formation crashes into your own ranks, then that half-heartbeat of silence before the screaming begins. It is a thing you and [character] have discussed more than once. While you both love the idea of employing horse troops of your own, the notion that your enemies might use them against you doesn't sit well. "There must be something that can be done!" [character] said in disgust as he banged his tankard of ale down on the table during one of your many late night conversations. You find yourself very much in agreement, and as your conversation continues to unfold, a plan begins to emerge. It would be a frightfully expensive proposition, no doubt, but perhaps it would be possible to incorporate anti-mounted tactics into your training curriculum, and if that proved possible, then all your troops, or at least all the troops you trained in [city] would fare much better against those hated horse troops...

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Truth Hurts

options.text: Brilliant! Amazing! The best ever!
Honestly, I dislike it.

events.text: [character], head of the powerful [family] family, would like to know what you think of his. The truth is, you hate it. It is. However, taking such a blunt approach to one of the more influential people in your realm may not be the most diplomatic action.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Twenty Saints

options.text: We will raise a monument to their sacrifice.
Lock the murderous general in chains.
God is not the ruler of mighty [rival].
Better leadership is needed in [city].

events.text: Subjects in the city of [city] have barricaded its Governor, [character], in the royal palace. One of his generals is accused of slaying twenty of his soldiers when they confessed their Christianity beliefs. The city's faithful are in an uproar over the murder of these honorable martyrs. [character] pleads for our help, though this is a disaster of his own making.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Wanderers

tip: As leader: Effect Unit: Scout → Trait Item Star Chart

options.text: Have [character] draw out a map of their movements.
Devote yourself to reading his work.
Maybe this work will lead us to new discoveries.

events.text: The phenomena known as planets, placed by the gods, are said to wander through the night sky. However, [character] says that the coming and going of these celestial bodies may not be as random as was once thought. Combining his own ideas with those of the other Astronomers who have come before, [character] has produced a grand treatise on the movement of the planets.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Wild Hunt

options.text: I cannot ignore destiny. I will hunt.
Such foolhardy rituals are beneath me.

events.text: The mystics have calculated, by means of their enigmatic astrology, that this is the year of the Wild Hunt. This ghostly chase is an ancient practice wherein the [title] ingests psychedelic herbs and enters a hallucinogenic dream state before joining a phantom hunting party. Your advisors suggest that you forgo this bizarre and potentially dangerous ritual, but the mystics claim that the arrival of the Wild Hunt is a sign you have been chosen by fate for some great destiny.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: They Do Not Belong

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee

options.text: This is not how followers of [religion] should act.
Proceed with laws that would restrict [religion].
Make [religion] our new state religion.

events.text: Followers of [religion] wish to strengthen their stranglehold on the nation's faith, proposing laws that would persecute other religions. These decrees have some support in the court, and we must decide where we stand. Deliberate targeting of [religion] subjects may cause more trouble than expected. Still, we must act.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: They Do Not Belong

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Melee

options.text: This is not how followers of [religion] should act.
Proceed with laws that would restrict [religion].
Make [religion] our new state religion.
