These decrees have some support in the court, and we must decide where we stand. Deliberate targeting of [religion] subjects may cause more trouble than expected. Still, we must act.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: They'll Never See It Coming...

options.text: Oh, I think a donation to our national treasury would be appropriate.
The gift of friendship is sufficient for now.

events.text: [tribe] Riders appear unexpectedly and uninvited in your Court. Grim-faced and full of purpose, they stride toward you confidently. "You will pay us a tribute in gold and food, or our armies will attack!" They declare simply. "Yes, yes, and we'll get to all that." You reply with an easy smile. "But first, let us offer you some refreshment. You must be tired after your long journey." They mistake your hospitality for fear as you weave them bit by bit into your web of honest charm. By the end of the afternoon, you have them eating out of the palm of your hand, and now that you've worked your special brand of magic, it's time to bring this unexpected visit to a satisfying conclusion. Having won the [tribe] over completely, what boon would you like to extract from them?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Thinkers and Tinkerers

options.text: We will happily lend the wisdom of our ministers in exchange for access to the best minds [character] can make available.
It's not what [character] wants, but let us trade resources for materials to better the lives of our people on a more practical level.
Alas, we are not in a position to take advantage of this offer.

events.text: In your experience, it is a rare Tribal Leader indeed who cares much for engineering, but that is indeed the case when it comes to [character]. The two of you have become fast friends, mostly on account of that shared passion. Recently, on one of his visits to your Court, [character] presented you with an intriguing opportunity. If you would be willing to share some of the wisdom of your ministers, he would be willing to dispatch some of his best thinkers and tinkerers to help your Realm thrive. It could be win-win. Interested?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Those Meddling [family]

options.text: Remove [character] from the Council as a warning.
Do nothing but keep an eye on them.

events.text: Talk abounds at court over the suspicious associations between the [family] Family and a delegation from [rival]. Your council member, [character], seems to be involved. What could they be scheming about?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Threat of Mutiny

options.text: [rival] will adopt freedom.
The court obeys the will of its [title].

events.text: The [family] family, enduring patrons of the oppressed, publicly decry the government's slavery laws, and they threaten a court mutiny if the policies are not reversed. With the will of the people behind them, the [family] are a powerful force.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Through Thick and Thin

options.text: Let us throw an lavish party in honor of [character] and to show our appreciation for his friendship.
We should honor the [tribe] as a whole, but still emphasize our friendhsip with [character].
Sadly, while we do admire the [tribe] and we like [character] very much, we lack the resources to demonstrate it in any meaningful way.

events.text: You and [character] have been through a lot together. Striking up an unlikely friendship, you've discovered over the course of time that you have more in common than you ever would have believed possible. Sure, your two Peoples squabble and fight now and again, but that has nothing to do with you and [character]. The bottom line is, you like him. He has been there for you and has seen you both at your best and at your worst. It occurs to you that you've got an enormous amount of political capital built up, and it wouldn't be hard to leverage that to radically improve relations with the [tribe]. It's simply a matter of resources and will. What, if anything, would you like to do?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Through the Smoke

options.text: A heroic deed deserves a statue and other accolades!
Bring [character]. Let us not lose sight of such talent.
Thank him for his service but don't make a fuss.

events.text: A lightning strike set off a nasty fire in your Realm that could have been disastrous. Fortunately, the Gods have smiled, and a hero presented himself just when you needed it most. [character] singlehandedly rescued more than a dozen people who were caught in the path of the blaze, including several children, then went back and helped get the fire under control. You have learned that such displays of courage can be of great value to a savvy leader...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Time for a Break

options.text: Relaxing and avoiding my duties.
Gambling with my closest friends.
Drinking and making merry.

events.text: Ruling a great nation takes its toll... Our court physician suggests that you retire to your private villa for a short rest. How do you wish to spend your time away?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Tiny Hands

options.text: Brilliant! Put them to work at once!
How dare [character] suggest such a thing!
I will fund an effort to feed and house these children.

events.text: [character] has grown ponderous in the last few weeks, surly and quick-tempered. Finally, he comes to you with his troubles. It seems the local prisons have become inundated with children. Beggars. Pickpockets. Thieves. "Perhaps there is something to be done with all these tiny hands." [character] proposes a labor force of child workers to aid in tasks too precise for larger men and women. "It is far more merciful than letting these urchins perish in the dungeons," he explains.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Tough As Nails

options.text: We should build an arena and start showing professional matches.
As amazing as it would be to host regular, professional matches, we can't afford something so extravagant. We can still beat the hell out of each other in Court though.

events.text: [character] is tough. He reminds you of...you. You like that. In fact, you both enjoy showing the world just how tough you are. Any time he puts in an appearance at your Court, fights inevitably break out. Not because there's bad blood between your people and the [tribe], but simply because it's an expression of the kinds of lives you lead. It's all surprisingly good natured, but it does occur to you that perhaps you could put that to constructive use. Formalize it in some way. Turn the contests of arms into a sport.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Trading Favors

options.text: Consider it done!
We cannot afford to pay this miscreant's debts, and we do not want him at Court.

events.text: [character] approaches you with a proposition. [character] is a talented merchant but also a bit of a miscreant who has run up considerable debts. If you could see your way clear to pay that debt and add him to your Court, [character] would be "most appreciative..."

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tribal Advocate on the Court

options.text: I want to improve diplomatic relations with the [tribe] through a Peace mission.
This is not the way I wish to conduct diplomacy.

events.text: [character], a [tribe] member of our court, is anxious to expand our diplomatic relationship with his people. He wants us to send [character] on a Tribe Peace Mission to the [tribe]. Shall we approve of his plan to propose a Peace deal?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
This is not the time.

events.text: An emissary from the [tribe] has arrived to propose closer ties between our peoples. “Mighty [character], long have our two peoples lived in peace and enjoyed a close relationship,” he announces. “We feel the time has come to sign a formal alliance. What say you?” The [tribe] could be a powerful ally, but of course, we may be drawn into their wars at inopportune times.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
This is not the time.

events.text: An emissary from the [tribe] has arrived to propose closer ties between our peoples. “Mighty [character], long have our two peoples lived in peace and enjoyed a close relationship,” he announces. “We feel the time has come to sign a formal alliance. What say you?” The [tribe] could be a powerful ally, but of course, we may be drawn into their wars at inopportune times.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
This is not the time.

events.text: A [tribe] envoy stands before you today, proposing that [rival] and the [tribe] sign a formal alliance to stand united against any who dare threaten your two realms. A strange people, prone to, they have nonetheless been good friends to your people for some time now.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
This is not the time.

events.text: A messenger from the [tribe] seeks an audience with you. “[character], we of the [tribe] seek your protection. The night is dark and full of terrors, but your empire is the shining light which can banish our fears. Sign an alliance with us and we shall surely enter a golden age!”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: An emissary sent by [character] has brought us an offer of alliance. [character], a brilliant builder, now desires to build a powerful union between our realms. “We must build an alliance which will stand the test of time” his emissary quotes.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: A captain bearing the seal of the famed commander [character] tells us that [character] is ready to lead our armies to victory if we will ally with him.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: [character] has made it known to us that he feels the time is right to bind our two nations with a historic alliance treaty, which he is sure will secure “peace in our time.”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: A champion of [character] has arrived at the court. She brings word that [character] wishes to sign an alliance with us in order to lead both our peoples to glory. “Think of the battles we could win, with the [tribe] and [rival] united!”, she excitedly adds.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: A clerk from the office of the fair-minded judge [character] has arrived bearing an injunction requesting an alliance between us forthwith. This will remedy the lack of judicial enforcement in the immediate area and bring relief to many plaintiffs to whom our individual realms cannot render aid on their own.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: A messenger has reached us from [character]. He says that he is under strict instructions to deliver the message exactly as [character] delivered it to him. The messenger seems to focus for a moment, strikes a powerful pose with a hand outstretched, and begins, “Our TWO peoples must become ONE!” He clenches his outstretched hand into a fist. “Only TOGETHER can we grow STRONG, can we PROSPER, can we CONQUER!” he thunders. He lowers his hand, growing solemn, and looking thoughtful, he continues “Truly, this is a ONCE in a lifetime opportunity to ENTWINE our realms into a beautiful TAPESTRY.” Suddenly, he looks pained, worried. “To turn down such an offer would be DISASTROUS, only a FOOL would do so.” The messenger collapses to the ground, spent. One courtier begins to applaud politely, but quickly stops when no one else joins in.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: You awaken and notice, with some alarm, that there is a note pinned to the headboard of your bed by a dagger. After a brief yet frantic search of your bed chambers you return and read the note. It is an offer of alliance from [character]. He apologizes for any alarm caused by the method of delivery, but he wished to make clear what kind of skills he could bring to the table.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: An aide to the erudite scholar [character] brings us an offer of alliance. [character] wishes to usher in a new era of peace and learning, unmatched since the reign of Ur-Nammu.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: An envoy from [character] has arrived. He reveals that [character], using his great tactical skill, has determined that an alliance with us is the optimal move to make at this time.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Tribal Alliance

options.text: We welcome an alliance with the [tribe].
I'm afraid that we cannot.

events.text: A holy messenger arrives from the [tribe]. She bears a message from the Zealot Archetype [character]. “The gods have spoken. An alliance between the [tribe] and [rival] is blessed in their eyes. Will you listen to their truth?”

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Tribal Mercenaries

options.text: See if you can find those famed Balearic Slingers.
Get some of those Numidians Cavalry.
No, our armies are strong. Now help me find that chicken!

events.text: While you are preparing for a festive sacrifice, [character] appears from the shadows of the temple startling you so much that you drop the sacrificial chicken... He asks if tribal mercenaries would be useful in boosting our army?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Tribal Tribute

options.text: Choose Food.
Choose Wood.
Choose Iron.

events.text: A council of [tribe] merchants arrives in the capital. They offer resources as a sign of political friendship. Which resource should we choose?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Trouble at Court

options.text: We must not appease [character].
[character] must step down to avoid unrest.
Find a mutually beneficial solution.

events.text: A series of escalating arguments and invectives has led to outright feuding at court. [character] has accused [character] of misguiding our armies with useless, outdated military tactics. He threatens to incite outrage among our soldiers if nothing is done. Ultimately, it is on us to resolve this dispute. Do we appease [character] or stand up for [character]?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Turncoats

options.text: Let us bring [character] into our service.
Let us bring the trademen into our fold.
Let's invite both [character] and the tradesmen into our Realm.
At present, we're in no position to take advantage of this opportunity.

events.text: As our war with the [tribe] heats up, an intriguing development occurs. It seems there are those among the [tribe] who are adamantly against fighting us. A small band of them have made their way in secret to your Court, and offer their assistance. One among them, [character], is a warrior of renown, and the others are tradesmen. It would be easy enough to take some or all of them into your service. What say you?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Tutelage

options.text: By all means! Let us take [character] under our wing.
We are in no position to grant this favor right now.

events.text: [character] has a problem and comes to you for assistance. It seems that [character] has some natural talent, but, without direction and a firm hand, is wasting it and getting himself into trouble on a regular basis. If you could provide him with training and add him to your Court, he'd gain much needed, real world experience, and [character] would owe you a favor...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Unhappy Peasants

options.text: Make the necessary sacrifices.
Our goods are too precious to waste.
The gods have only tested our mettle. Behold, already the skies darken with rain!

events.text: Temple priests claim the gods are angry with us. They demand a sacrifice to help bring rains and end the poor harvests. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Uninvited Guest

options.text: Ignore the slight, and continue with the meeting.
Scold [character] and send him away.
Introduce them and make lighthearted conversation.

requirements.label: Heckler / Cruel
tip: The leader must have one of: Heckler; Cruel

options.text: Mock the Heir's attempts at diplomacy.

events.text: Preparing to meet with [character] to review current diplomatic ties with [rival], you are surprised to find [character] waiting with him in the council chamber. It appears [character] has invited himself to the "private" meeting. He turns to [character]. "As the future ruler of [rival], we have much to discuss."

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Unprophetable Actions

options.text: We shall have to end their world at least!

events.text: The [tribe] seek our downfall. Little is known of their strange ways, but rumor has it that their holy women have foretold that we are destined to bring about the end of the world if not destroyed.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Vast Proportions

options.text: Let us spare no expense in the endeavor, so if these creatures really do exist, we secure enough for both ourselves and for [character].
Even if these stories prove true, we simply do not have the resources at present to fund a proper expedition, but keep the drinks and the tales coming!

events.text: [character] has been spending a lot of time at your Court in recent months and the two of you have struck up an easy friendship. He has a seemingly unending supply of wild tales of far off places. One story in particular that keeps getting mentioned really piques your interest. It revolves around the discovery of gigantic beasts called Elephants that could be used for both peace or war. The more you hear of them, the more you realize you have to have some. The question, of course, is how. "Well, if it is something you're serious about, I do know the way. We'd have to travel quite a distance and such an expedition would be expensive, but it is possible..." Indeed. In truth, it is merely a question of resources...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Violent Altercation

options.text: The Heir must be punished for his actions.
It is not my place to discipline the next ruler.

requirements.label: Charming character / Diplomat
tip: The leader must have one of: Charming character (a character trait); Diplomat

options.text: Host a feast where the two will resolve their differences.

events.text: A heated debate between [character] and [character] on the streets of [city] explodes into a physical altercation. Taking a strip of wood from a carpenter's bench, [character] beats [character] to within an inch of his life, leaving his rival battered and broken. Some in court suspect that [character]'s fury is a result of your closeness to [character], but he has refused to discuss the matter.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: War Machines

options.text: A worthy gift indeed! Thank [character] and lavish him with praise and hold a feast in his honor!
Offer to help train [character]'s warriors in exchange for the amazing gift.

events.text: You and [character] have spent quite a lot of time together lately, conducting joint operations to train your troops and his tribal warriors. Both of you are particularly adept at laying siege to fortified positions and the practice has been paying off for both of you. Just now [character] arrives grinning at your court. "I have a surprise for you." He says simply, beckoning you off your throne to investigate. Arriving in the courtyard, the sight of the war machine takes your breath away. "I call it a 'Field Ass'" He says proudly. "A gift."

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Wardens of the Wilds

rewards.text: Begin project: Wardens of the Wilds

options.text: Let us turn this idea into a reality by establishing The Wardens of the Wilds.
Tempting as the idea is, it's something we can't afford right now, but by all means, we should continue our rides with [character].

events.text: You and [character] have been spending an increasing amount of time together, riding in and exploring the wilderness. It occurs to you during one of these outings that an intimate familiarity with the Wilds should be built into your troop training paradigm, if not everywhere, then at the very least in [city], and it could be. It definitely could be...

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Warrior Tradition

options.text: How can we not embrace this idea? Let us do so at once!
It is very tempting, but no. Our current resources simply don't allow for it.

events.text: [character] has been spending an increasing amount of time in your Court. The two of you are kindred spirits and have shared many tankards of ale and many late night conversations. Recently he brought up the possibility of formalizing the proud Warrior Tradition you share and incorporating it into the training regimen for both your Peoples. It's an idea that makes a tremendous amount of sense to you. The issue, as ever, is cost...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Weak Will

options.text: Yes, slavery is the natural order.
I will not respond to empty threats.
He should remember his place.

events.text: [character] of the [family] family accuses you of possessing a weak will with regards to your subjects. "What next? Freedom for the beasts of the field, for the sheep in the pastures?" He leaves you with a warning. "Put the people in their place, or the court will force your hand."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Winters to Come

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: Let us pray together for the gods' mercy.
We must then be prepared.

events.text: [character] is looking especially grave as he draws you aside for a private word "The omens are not good, the winters are to become harsher than our people have seen in generations."

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Wisdom of the Highland Clans

rewards.text: Begin project: Codex of Highland Wisdom

options.text: We should not only hire scribes to pen a Codex of Highland wisdom to keep in [city], but also give [character] credit for being the inspiration behind it.
No. Unfortunately, we lack the resources to do anything like that at this time. But we should continue to celebrate our shared heritage!

events.text: Highlanders aren't like other folk, a thing both you and [character] know well as it is a background you have in common. As a result of your shared heritage and training, the two of you have struck up an unlikely friendship and have spent many hours in each other's company, both at your Court and traveling together exploring the wilds. During one of these frequent outings, [character] mentions how wonderful it would be if the collected wisdom of the highlanders could be written down and more widely shared. The more you think about that, the more you like the idea. After all, few people can do more with less than the folk of the highlands. There would be a cost involved, of course, but it is an idea well worth considering. What say you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Wondrous Nation

options.text: Send your diplomats to seek out this foreign land.
[rival] will shine brighter than all others!
They could just as easily be enemies. We will tend to our own lands.

events.text: The merchants, diplomats, sailors, and those who tread the roads of the world whisper of a great and distant nation with a magnificent city at the heart. This place is filled with monuments the like of which have never been seen. Your court ask if we should attempt to make contact with this distant land. Perhaps these will be new allies in the days ahead?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Word of a Coup

options.text: Tell our spies to intensify their search.
We cannot afford a lengthy investigation.

events.text: Spies suspect your disgruntled brother, [character], of plotting to take your seat on the throne. We worried this might happen. How shall we respond?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Writing on the Wall

options.text: Prophets advise us to avoid the mistakes of our predecessor, [character].
Scholars believe I am chosen by the divine to rule forever.
These scribbles mean nothing.

events.text: The morning after a feast, servants rush to your chambers, describing a scene of grave portents. Mysterious writing has appeared across the walls of the banquet hall. Shaken guards insist that the words were "authored by the hand of God." Scholars and prophets from all over [rival] try to decipher the message. Whose explanation shall we believe?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Yoga Practice

options.text: Join him, for a time.
Commit yourself to joining his meditation.
Even the breathing seems to help.

events.text: [character] has been following a new practice, combining his ascetic lifestyle with his [religion] religion to practice a form of meditation based around ‘yoking’ the senses.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [character] Rebels

options.text: Mobilize as many as we can muster to defend.
I will go to [city] myself - and it will be my pleasure to mock [character] personally when he is defeated.

events.text: [character] has never accepted not being king, and his mother [character] never hid her support for his royal ambitions. As such, the news arriving from [city] is hardly a surprise. [character] found enough allies among the disgruntled [family] nobles to challenge your rule openly. A long-standing family feud is about to turn the streets of [city] red with blood.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Praise

options.text: You have my blessing.
I shall be the one to sponsor the festival.

events.text: [character] approaches you one morning, asking for your blessing for him to sponsor an upcoming [religion] religious festival in the [family] name. Doing so would please the believers, but letting other families sponsor such religious events could erode the tie between crown and faith.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: [tribe] Celebration

options.text: Bring members of the [family] family.
The [family] should be included.
Forestall any rivalries by inviting both Family.
I will attend alone, reserving all honor for myself.

events.text: The [tribe] would be honored if you attended a celebratory feast in honor of your developing friendship. You may wish to bring along important Family representatives to strengthen ties across Tribe and nation. The [family] and [family] Family have both expressed interest in meeting with the [tribe].
